news.title: Xabi Alonso on managing ‘emotional’ away games and formation flexibility
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈管理“情绪化”客场比赛和阵型灵活性
news.body_en: Chelsea hit the road for the first time since our 3-0 defeat to Brentford as we travel to Everton tomorrow, and Xabi Alonso is determined to see his side deal with what he expects will be a ‘high-demand’ game. Our second visit to the Hill Dickinson Stadium comes following last weekend’s emphatic 5-1 win over Bournemouth. That victory was the perfect return to action after not only the prolonged international break, but also the disappointing result at the Gtech Stadium that preceded it. Against our west London neighbours, the Blues conceded three second-half goals to fall to defeat. There were lessons to be learned. And Alonso hopes that experience, while painful, will prove beneficial in what he expects will be a hostile environment at the Hill Dickinson Stadium ‘It’s going to be tough at Everton, but we are looking forward to the intensity of the game, a high-demand game, high tempo,’ said Alonso. ‘I haven't been in the stadium, but they've told me it's a nice one with good atmosphere, so we are looking forward to it. ‘I want that we compete and show what it takes to win away Premier League games in tough stadiums where the supporters create a great emotional energy. I want us to deal with that by playing, but by competing as well. For sure, the experience at Brentford is not forgotten.’ With 15 goals scored in our opening six top-flight games of the season, Alonso wants the Blues to stay proficient in the final third while shoring things up at the other end, which he has emphasised will increase our chances of winning challenging games, such as the one we can expect on Merseyside. Against Bournemouth, Alonso adjusted his side’s shape out of possession, with the Blues dropping back into a 4-4-2 formation. Our manager explained why he will remain flexible in how he sets his team up depending on the opposition, while noting certain elements of play matter more. He explained: ‘We want to be flexible, but we also want to be solid whenever we are pressing high, or a little bit lower. We need to think that the distances are right and that the balance is the right one, so we chose that way against Bournemouth. ‘Everton is going to be different. They do many good things and have very good players who have experience. So those principles are important. ‘It can be in a 4-4-2, it can be in a 5-2-3, but the distances, how you help and how you have a good balance, this is what you need to defend. After that, what you do with the ball is another thing.’
news.body_zh: 切尔西自 3-0 输给布伦特福德以来首次上路，明天我们将前往埃弗顿，哈维·阿隆索决心让他的球队应对他所期望的一场“高需求”的比赛。我们第二次造访希尔迪金森体育场是在上周末 5-1 战胜伯恩茅斯之后。这场胜利不仅是在漫长的国际比赛日之后的完美回归，也是在之前的 Gtech 体育场令人失望的结果之后的完美回归。对阵我们伦敦西部的邻居时，蓝军在下半场丢了三个球，最终落败。有一些教训值得吸取。阿隆索希望这段经历虽然痛苦，但在他预计希尔迪金森体育场的敌对环境中将是有益的。“在埃弗顿会很艰难，但我们期待比赛的强度，一场高要求的比赛，快节奏的比赛，”阿隆索说。 “我没有去过体育场，但他们告诉我这是一个很好的体育场，气氛很好，所以我们很期待。 “我希望我们能够在艰苦的体育场内竞争并展示如何赢得客场英超比赛，那里的球迷会产生巨大的情感能量。我希望我们通过比赛来解决这个问题，但也通过竞争来解决这个问题。当然，在布伦特福德的经历不会被忘记。”我们在本赛季的前六场顶级联赛中打进了15个进球，阿隆索希望蓝军在最后三分之一的比赛中保持熟练，同时在另一端支撑球队，他强调这将增加我们赢得具有挑战性的比赛的机会，例如我们可以在默西塞德郡期待的那场比赛。对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中，阿隆索在控球后调整了球队的阵型，蓝军重新回到了4-4-2阵型。我们的经理解释了为什么他会根据对手的情况灵活地安排球队，同时指出比赛的某些要素更重要。他解释说：“我们希望保持灵活性，但每当我们压高或压低一点时，我们也希望保持稳定。我们需要认为距离是正确的，平衡是正确的，所以我们在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中选择了这种方式。 “埃弗顿将会有所不同。他们做了很多好事，并且拥有非常优秀、有经验的球员。所以这些原则很重要。 “可以是4-4-2阵型，也可以是5-2-3阵型，但是距离、如何提供帮助以及如何保持良好的平衡，这就是你需要防守的。之后，你如何处理球就是另一回事了。”

Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the official ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Everton
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确认了切尔西队为埃弗顿效力的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso provided updates on the fitness of Emmanuel Emegha and Jamie Gittens ahead of our Premier League trip to Everton – and emphasised the influence Reece James will continue to have during his recovery from knee surgery. After returning to action with an impressive 5-1 win over Bournemouth at Stamford Bridge, we head out on the road this weekend, leaving London for the first time this season. Alonso confirmed before our journey to Merseyside that there were no fresh fitness concerns to highlight. However, Emegha and Gittens remain unavailable. On Emegha, the Blues manager explained: 'He is not ready for tomorrow; he felt something yesterday (Thursday), a little thing. He is going to be training next week, but he's still not 100 per cent fit to be playing in the game [against Everton].' The Dutch forward has yet to make his debut for the Blues after his summer arrival from Strasbourg, but Alonso expects the 23-year-old to have a big impact when he is fit and available. He said: 'When he is fit, he is very special. He is 1.95 metres, is quick, he attacks space, and he is a threat. He needs to be fully fit and at this moment he’s had little things, and unfortunately has not been available. 'But we are looking forward to him feeling good and helping the team, and it's going to be difficult for defenders when he is in good shape. Gittens, meanwhile, suffered an injury while on international duty with England Under-21s and Alonso confirmed there is no date pencilled in for the winger's return. 'Not yet, it’s still a few weeks,' he said. It was confirmed this morning that James had undergone surgery on a knee injury sustained in training last Friday. There is no timeframe for the Blues skipper's return, but Alonso says the 26-year-old will remain a key presence in the dressing room. ‘We are all disappointed, and especially for him,' said Alonso. 'He wanted to have a good start after the international break, but in the last training session he picked up an injury. We wanted to be cautious and wait for the result of the tests. 'Now, the surgery has been successful and we will keep supporting him. He will be close to the team as he is a great influence even when he is not available. We wish him a great recovery and while we don’t set timelines, he will be out for several weeks. ‘He is so proud to be playing for this club, and he is so proud to have reached this moment [in his career] because he has played many years and gone through many different stages. 'So he takes that responsibility in a very natural way, with his own way of leadership. He is so respected by his team-mates and he has the support of everyone.'
news.body_zh: 在我们前往埃弗顿的英超联赛之前，哈比·阿隆索提供了伊曼纽尔·埃梅加和杰米·吉滕斯的最新健康状况信息，并强调了里斯·詹姆斯在膝盖手术恢复期间将继续产生的影响。在斯坦福桥以 5-1 击败伯恩茅斯的令人印​​象深刻的比赛后，我们本周末将启程前往客场，这是本赛季首次离开伦敦。阿隆索在前往默西塞德郡之前证实，没有新的健康问题需要强调。然而，Emegha 和 Gittens 仍然无法使用。在谈到埃梅加时，蓝军主帅解释道：“他还没有为明天做好准备；他已经做好了准备。”昨天（星期四）他感觉到了一些东西，一件小事。他将于下周进行训练，但他仍然没有百分百适合参加（对阵埃弗顿的）比赛。这位荷兰前锋在夏季从斯特拉斯堡抵达后尚未为蓝军首次亮相，但阿隆索预计这位 23 岁的球员在健康和可用时会产生巨大影响。他说：“当他健康的时候，他是非常特别的。他身高1.95米，速度快，攻击空间大，是一个威胁。他需要完全恢复健康，目前他的身体状况不佳，不幸的是还没有上场。 “但我们期待他感觉良好并帮助球队，当他状态良好时，后卫会很困难。与此同时，吉滕斯在英格兰21岁以下国家队比赛中受伤，阿隆索证实这位边锋的回归日期还没有确定。 “还没有，还有几周的时间，”他说。今天早上证实，詹姆斯因上周五训练中膝盖受伤接受了手术。目前还没有蓝军队长回归的时间表，但阿隆索表示，这位 26 岁的球员仍将是更衣室的关键人物。 “我们都很失望，尤其是对他，”阿隆索说。 “他希望在国际比赛日后能有一个好的开局，但在最后一次训练中他受伤了。我们想保持谨慎并等待测试结果。现在，手术已经成功，我们将继续支持他。他将与球队保持密切联系，因为即使他不在场，他也会产生巨大的影响力。我们祝愿他康复，虽然我们没有设定时间表，但他将缺席几周的时间。 “他非常自豪能够为这家具乐部效力，他也非常自豪能够达到[职业生涯]的这一刻，因为他已经踢了很多年，经历了许多不同的阶段。 “所以他以一种非常自然的方式和他自己的领导方式承担了这一责任。他深受队友的尊重，也得到了所有人的支持。”

news.title: Reggie Watson on his 'superpower' and Player of the Month win
news.title_zh: 雷吉·沃森谈他的“超能力”和本月最佳球员
news.body_en: It’s been a season full of memorable moments for Reggie Watson, who has already made his senior debut for Chelsea, captained England Under-17s and won the Premier League 2 Player of the Month award. Watson has stepped up to the Cobham Next Gen squad this season at just 16 years old and has been key to the Blues’ impressive start. He has been rewarded for his form and is looking to progress even further as the campaign progresses. We sat down with Watson to speak about the season so far and what’s to come from him and the CNG team in 2026/27. After returning from international duty, Watson was presented with his PL2 Player of the Month award for September 2026. He won the award after scoring three goals in two matches, taking him up to five in all competitions. Reflecting on the accolade, Watson said: ‘It’s been a great start, we are near the top of the table and there’s been some great performances from myself and by the team. We’ve got some good results and hopefully we can just push on. I think I’ve done well, winning Player of the Month shows I’ve stepped up to the level. ‘I’ve been very pleased. Scoring five goals is quite nice, I don’t think I’ve scored that many in my life but hopefully we can just push on even more with some even better performances.’ Those goals included a stunning free-kick against Arsenal. Watson described his striking ability from dead-ball situations as one of his ‘superpowers’. He said: ‘I practise them quite a lot, but it was natural when I was younger. Once I started working on it with some coaches they have helped make them even better. It’s become a superpower of mine.’ At such an early stage in his career, Watson has shown great maturity in adapting to Under-21s football and senior football. He has impressed under Cobham Next Gen head coach Harry Hudson in the league and cup competitions, becoming a key cog in the Blues' midfield. Speaking on working under Hudson and the CNG training environment, Watson revealed: ‘I enjoy it, when I have trained with them it’s been fun and in the games we’ve showed our levels. ‘It’s very competitive and we have a good relationship on the pitch. It shows in games this season when we’ve gone behind and we’ve stepped up. It demands a high level every single day and being an overall complete player.’ Throughout his time with Chelsea, Watson has continued to maintain those high standards and it has led to him being involved with the first team. In fact, after spending time with the senior squad during pre-season, Watson was able to make his competitive debut when he started against Leeds United in the Carabao Cup. 'It was a crazy moment. I was quite nervous the day before because I didn’t really know if I was going to play at all. Once I found out I was starting, I was kind of shocked, but confident. 'Walking out onto the pitch I got crazy goosebumps seeing all the fans and the atmosphere. Starting for Chelsea at 16 is such an honour, I think I was ready for it though. 'There are some big characters in the first team who help the young boys out and when you look around you see talented players everywhere. I was shocked because it’s like: “Wow, I’m playing with these players”.’ Watson’s senior debut made him the youngest player to ever feature for Chelsea in the Carabao Cup, although it wasn’t his first taste of senior football for the Blues. He was also part of the first-team squad who went out to Australia and Asia for our pre-season tour. Watson said: ‘The first game I started and played the full game which I didn’t expect. Training sessions with the first team were very valuable.’ Watson was called up for the England Under-17s squad during the last international window and captained the Young Lions in their matches against the Republic of Ireland, Israel, Venezuela and Germany. Looking back on the experience, the midfielder said: ‘It’s very competitive when you play for England, as you would expect playing for your country and playing against some top nations. It’s probably the biggest pride in football, captaining your country, it’s an honour.’ Across all competitions, Watson has found the back of the net on five occasions for Cobham Next Gen. The squad have some big tests ahead, but Watson is relishing the opportunity to face any challenge that comes his way and aims to ‘win everything’. ‘I’m very excited, I think we can get wins. I’m hoping for solid performances and maybe I can chip in with a few goals again,’ he said. His next opportunity to do so arrives this evening, when we travel to Stoke City for a 7pm kick-off in the Premier League 2. CFC+ subscribers can watch the game live on the Chelsea Official App and website, with highlights available to all supporters the following day.
news.body_zh: 对于雷吉·沃森来说，这是一个充满难忘时刻的赛季，他已经在切尔西完成了自己的成年队首秀，担任英格兰 17 岁以下国家队队长，并赢得了英超联赛 2 月最佳球员奖。沃森本赛季年仅 16 岁就加入了科巴姆下一代队，并且是蓝军取得令人印象深刻的开局的关键。他因其出色的表现而获得了奖励，并希望随着竞选的进展取得进一步的进步。我们与 Watson 坐下来讨论了本赛季迄今为止的情况以及他和 CNG 团队在 2026/27 年的发展。从国家队归来后，沃森被授予 2026 年 9 月 PL2 月度最佳球员奖。他在两场比赛中攻入 3 个进球，使他在所有比赛中的进球数上升到 5 个。谈到这一荣誉，沃森表示：“这是一个很好的开始，我们已经接近积分榜榜首，我自己和团队都表现出色。”我们已经取得了一些不错的成绩，希望我们能够继续前进。我认为我做得很好，赢得本月最佳球员表明我已经达到了水平。 ‘我已经非常高兴了。进五个球非常好，我不认为我一生中进过那么多球，但希望我们能够以更好的表现继续前进。”这些进球包括对阵阿森纳的惊人任意球。沃森将他在死球情况下的打击能力描述为他的“超能力”之一。他说：“我经常练习它们，但在我年轻的时候这是很自然的。当我开始与一些教练一起工作时，他们帮助我变得更好。它已经成为我的超能力。”在职业生涯的早期阶段，沃森在适应 21 岁以下足球和成年足球方面就表现出了极大的成熟。在科巴姆下一代主教练哈里·哈德森的带领下，他在联赛和杯赛中给人留下了深刻的印象，成为蓝军中场的关键一环。谈到在哈德森和 CNG 训练环境下的工作，沃森透露：“我很享受，当我和他们一起训练时，这很有趣，在比赛中我们展示了我们的水平。” “竞争非常激烈，我们在球场上有着良好的关系。这在本赛季的比赛中体现出来，当我们落后时，我们会奋起直追。这要求每天都保持高水平，并成为一名全面的球员。”在切尔西效力期间，沃森一直保持着这些高标准，这使得他能够加入一线队。事实上，在季前赛与一线队一起度过一段时光后，沃森在卡拉宝杯对阵利兹联的比赛中首发出场，完成了他的正式比赛首秀。 “那是一个疯狂的时刻。前一天我非常紧张，因为我真的不知道自己是否会参加比赛。当我发现自己要开始时，我有点震惊，但充满信心。 “当我走到球场上时，看到所有的球迷和现场的气氛，我起鸡皮疙瘩。 16 岁就为切尔西首发真是一种荣幸，不过我想我已经做好了准备。 “一线队中有一些大人物帮助年轻球员走出困境，当你环顾四周时，你会发现到处都有才华横溢的球员。我很震惊，因为这就像：“哇，我正在和这些球员一起踢球”。沃森的成年队首秀使他成为切尔西在联赛杯中出场的最年轻的球员，尽管这并不是他第一次为蓝军成年队踢球。他也是前往澳大利亚和亚洲参加我们季前赛的一线队的一员。沃森说：“第一场比赛我首发并踢满了整场比赛，这是我没想到的。与一线队的训练非常有价值。沃森在上个国际比赛窗口期间被征召入英格兰 17 岁以下国家队，并在对阵爱尔兰共和国、以色列、委内瑞拉和德国的比赛中担任青年狮队队长。回顾这段经历，这位中场球员说道：“当你为英格兰队效力时，竞争非常激烈，因为你会期望为自己的国家队效力，并与一些顶级国家队比赛。”为你的国家队担任队长可能是足球界最大的骄傲，这是一种荣誉。”在所有比赛中，沃森已经为科巴姆下一代队五次破门。球队即将面临一些重大考验，但沃森很高兴有机会面对他遇到的任何挑战，并致力于“赢得一切”。 “我非常兴奋，我认为我们能够取得胜利。我希望能有稳定的表现，也许我可以再次进球，”他说。 他的下一次机会将在今晚到来，届时我们将前往斯托克城参加英超 2 场比赛晚上 7 点的开球。CFC+ 订阅者可以在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上观看比赛直播，第二天所有支持者均可观看精彩集锦。

news.title: Morgan Rogers on ‘hungry’ Joao Pedro and confidence in attack
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯谈“饥饿”若昂·佩德罗和进攻信心
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers has praised Joao Pedro’s work for the team on and off the ball, explaining why the Brazilian is such a pleasure to play alongside in the Chelsea attack. Having missed the trip to Brentford due to injury, Joao Pedro was back in the starting line-up for Saturday’s home game against Bournemouth, and showed what we had been missing with two clinical second-half goals. That, along with a brace by Jordan Henderson and Rogers’ own strike, helped us to get back to winning ways in emphatic style with a 5-1 victory over the Cherries at Stamford Bridge. Joao Pedro’s contribution took him to five goals in as many Premier League appearances in 2026/27, already well on his way to matching his tally of 15 in his debut campaign with the Blues in that competition, and drawing praise from his team-mate for his impact on the team. ‘I think his hunger to score goals, his hunger to work for the team is massive,’ said Rogers when asked what the Brazilian brings to Chelsea. ‘Especially for me, where I play on the pitch, it really helps me loads. He always gives me an option. I can always play off him, he can play off me. ‘I think he's a massive part of us, not just scoring goals as well, he works so hard. The relentless running in the channel and working defensively as well for the team. ‘He’s on the top of his game right now and it's really good for Chelsea that he's doing so. ‘It’s not all he's focused on, but a lot of his focus is on getting goals, being in the box. He worked on it in training about arriving, getting in the box and scoring goals and he's been doing that every game since I've been here.’ Joao Pedro and Rogers scored three goals between them against the Cherries, while Cole Palmer had a big hand in both Henderson strikes. It was yet another example of how well that attacking trio have gelled to make a flying start to this season. However, Rogers is quick to point out that it is a team effort and there is still plenty more to come from the Blues attack in terms of creating chances, despite us already finding the net 23 times in our eight games so far in 2026/27. ‘As an attacking threat, it’s not just us three either, but as an attacking threat we're quite deadly in those situations,’ he said. ‘It's about how often we can get in there, and it's still a work in progress on getting there more times than we have done. But when we do get there, we're quite confident in each other we're going to score and we're going to create. ‘So it's a positive that we've taken from the start of the season. It's just about keeping it going now.’ That tally of 23 includes four goals and four assists from Rogers himself, who has wasted no time settling into his new surroundings since joining Chelsea from Aston Villa in the summer. It is something he puts down to the trust shown in him by his fellow Blues. ‘I'm feeling really good when I go out there, feeling really confident. The players and the staff allow me to be me, which is the most important thing, and I can just play my game and focus on that. ‘I've still got improvements that I want to make in my game, but I'm happy with the start. I think the start's the important thing and you try and get fans on your side, try to get the players on your side, which is tough. ‘So I'm glad that I can do that, but it's just about moving forward with the team. It's a long project and it's going in the right direction.’
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯赞扬了若奥·佩德罗在有球和无球时为球队所做的工作，并解释了为什么巴西人如此乐意在切尔西的进攻中并肩作战。由于受伤错过了前往布伦特福德的比赛，若昂·佩德罗在周六主场对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中回到了首发阵容，并通过下半场的两个冷静进球向我们展示了我们所缺少的东西。再加上乔丹·亨德森的梅开二度和罗杰斯的进球，帮助我们在斯坦福桥以 5-1 战胜樱桃队，重回胜利之路。若昂·佩德罗的贡献使他在 2026/27 赛季的英超联赛出场次数中打入 5 个进球，已经有望追平他在蓝军首秀中打入的 15 个进球，并因其对球队的影响而受到队友的赞扬。当被问及巴西人给切尔西带来什么时，罗杰斯说道：“我认为他对进球的渴望，他对为球队工作的渴望是巨大的。” “特别是对我来说，我在球场上踢球，这真的对我很有帮助。他总是给我一个选择。我总能打败他，他也能打败我。 “我认为他是我们的重要组成部分，不仅仅是进球，他工作非常努力。在通道中坚持不懈的奔跑以及为球队提供防守。 “他现在正处于比赛的巅峰，他这样做对切尔西来说真的很有好处。 “这并不是他关注的全部，但他的大部分注意力都集中在进球、留在禁区内。他在训练中致力于到达、进入禁区和进球，自从我来到这里以来，他在每场比赛中都这样做。”若昂·佩德罗和罗杰斯在对阵樱桃队的比赛中打进了三个进球，而科尔·帕尔默在亨德森的两次进球中都发挥了重要作用。这是进攻三人组在本赛季取得良好开局的又一个例子。然而，罗杰斯很快指出，这是团队的努力，尽管我们在 2026/27 赛季迄今为止的 8 场比赛中已经进了 23 球，但蓝军的进攻在创造机会方面还有很多工作要做。 “作为进攻威胁，不仅仅是我们三个人，但作为进攻威胁，我们在这种情况下是相当致命的，”他说。 “这关乎我们能够进入那里的频率，而且这仍然是一项正在进行的工作，我们需要比我们去过的次数更多。”但当我们真的到达那里时，我们对彼此非常有信心，我们会得分，我们会创造机会。 “所以这是我们从赛季初就获得的积极成果。现在就是要继续保持下去。”23 粒进球中包括罗杰斯本人的 4 个进球和 4 次助攻，自从夏天从阿斯顿维拉加盟切尔西以来，罗杰斯就没有浪费时间适应新的环境。他将这归功于他的蓝军同胞对他的信任。 “当我出去的时候，我感觉非常好，感觉非常自信。球员和工作人员允许我做我自己，这是最重要的事情，我可以专注于我的比赛。 “我仍然想在比赛中做出改进，但我对开始感到满意。我认为开局很重要，你要努力让球迷站在你这边，努力让球员站在你这边，这很困难。 “所以我很高兴我能做到这一点，但这只是为了与团队一起前进。这是一个长期的项目，而且正在朝着正确的方向发展。”

news.title: Everton vs Chelsea: All you need to know
news.title_zh: 埃弗顿 vs 切尔西：你需要知道的一切
news.body_en: Chelsea venture out of the capital for the first time this season with our second Premier League visit to Everton’s Hill Dickinson Stadium. Club historian Rick Glanvill and club statistician Paul Dutton preview the first of two matches in Liverpool this month. The Blues’ most recent action in this 12.30pm Saturday time-slot was also on Merseyside – a 1-1 draw at Anfield in May – and we are unbeaten in the past ten such fixtures, winning eight of them. Hosts Everton remain unbeaten this term after Sunday’s 2-2 draw at Hull City, when they netted the first league goals the Tigers have conceded on Humberside. This fixture, played every season since 1989, takes the current top flight’s third-highest-scoring attack to the home of its joint-best defence. Last weekend’s pulping of the Cherries means the Blues have one win, four goals and two points more than at the same stage last season. Xabi Alonso’s side are the Premier League’s early strikers, breaking the deadlock on five occasions an average of just three minutes into the game. Only Brentford (six) and Manchester City (five) have struck first with such regularity, and have averaged 36 and 35 minutes respectively to do so, 30-plus minutes longer than Chelsea. It is a good habit to take to Merseyside, where even before Everton’s switch to their waterfront home, Chelsea have earned scant returns down the years. But the Blues will be especially determined to avenge our only previous appearance at the new stadium earlier this year, a chastening 3-0 loss. A win would see Chelsea leapfrog the Toffees and potentially rise as high as fourth, should Brentford fail to beat Liverpool in the other west London-Merseyside clash later on Saturday. Liverpool (50) is the only league away trip in which Chelsea have suffered more defeats than at Everton (44, same as Arsenal). Goodison Park was the setting for 43 of those, but March’s 3-0 defeat at the Hill Dickinson Stadium was the Blues’ biggest loss at Everton since the 4-1 of October 1987, during John Hollins’ ill-fated tenure as manager. Up to then, Chelsea were unbeaten in four meetings with the Toffees, three of them wins. However, Jorginho’s penalty in August 2022 was our last winner at Goodison, ending a run of four straight losses on that side of Stanley Park. The first win there came back in April 1908, courtesy of George Hilsdon, ‘Gatling Gun’ being responsible for three without reply on the day. At the opening of the first season following World War One, on 30 August 1919, Chelsea shocked the pre-war defending champions by winning 3-2 on Merseyside. Three years later, the Blues repeated the scoreline, but it would then be 26 years before all the points returned to west London from Goodison with another 3-2 win, new talisman Roy Bentley opening the scoring. Our only victory for 21 years was a 3-0 (two goals for Les Stubbs) in October 1956, but in March 1969 goals from Alan Birchenall and Ian Hutchinson claimed the spoils for Dave Sexton’s Kings of the King’s Road. Then, in December 1984, new signing Gordon Davies’ hat-trick edged a toe-to-toe 4-3 battle, while a rare Steve Clarke strike settled the contest four years later. The same result marked the Blues’ first Premier League foray to Goodison, Robert Fleck grabbing the headlines. From 2001 to 2010, Chelsea were unbeaten home and away to Everton across all competitions. That included the 2009 FA Cup final win and Didier Drogba’s spectacular late winner for a 3-2 victory in December 2006. Two goals from Frank Lampard in a 2-1 win just before New Year 2012 began our best-ever run of three wins from five visits.  One of them was the topsy-turvy 6-3 in August 2014, in which Diego Costa struck twice, and another was a show of three second-half goals in 21 minutes to win 3-0 in 2017. The 1-0 in 2022 is Chelsea’s only success since then. Chelsea (50) and Everton (44) have committed the fewest fouls in the Premier League so far this season. Joao Pedro has found the back of the net with five of his 13 shots to date in the Premier League. The Blues have the second-best conversion rate of shots-to-goals in the top flight (18.29 per cent), only behind Man City (19.28 per cent). Everton have recorded the most high turnovers resulting in a shot (14) in the current campaign, but only one of those has resulted in a goal. Between them, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer have set up 24 attempts on goal this season. Chelsea have notched six goals inside the opening seven minutes of league matches this season, 40 per cent of our total. Four were scored in the opening three minutes, one behind the Blues’ club record – set over the entire title-winning 2014/15 season – and two shy of the Premier League record of six set by Manchester United in 2010/11. In the 5-1 beating of Bournemouth last Saturday, Jordan Henderson (36 years and 115 days old) became Chelsea’s oldest English goalscorer since John Terry netted against Watford in May 2017 (36 years and 159 days). The only player to score and assist quicker in a Premier League game than Henderson against the Cherries (two minutes, 29 seconds) was Emile Heskey against Derby County in April 1998, inside the opening two minutes.
news.body_zh: 切尔西本赛季首次走出首都，第二次在英超联赛中造访埃弗顿的希尔迪金森体育场。俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔和俱乐部统计学家保罗·达顿预览了本月利物浦两场比赛中的第一场。蓝军在周六中午 12 点 30 分的最近一场比赛也是在默西塞德郡 – 5 月份在安菲尔德 1-1 战平 – 我们在过去 10 场此类比赛中保持不败，赢得了其中的 8 场。周日2-2战平赫尔城后，东道主埃弗顿本赛季保持不败，他们打进了老虎队对阵亨伯赛德队的第一个联赛失球。这场比赛自 1989 年以来每个赛季都会举行，将目前顶级联赛第三高得分的进攻带到了并列最佳防守的主场。上周末击败樱桃队意味着蓝军取得一场胜利、四个进球、比上赛季同期多两分。哈维·阿隆索的球队是英超联赛的早期前锋，平均开场仅三分钟就五次打破僵局。只有布伦特福德（6 次）和曼城（5 次）能够如此频繁地率先进球，并且场均进球时间分别为 36 和 35 分钟，比切尔西多出 30 多分钟。去默西塞德郡是一个好习惯，即使在埃弗顿搬到他们的海滨主场之前，切尔西多年来也没有获得多少回报。但蓝军将特别决心为我们今年早些时候在新球场的唯一一次亮相——0-3 惨败——报仇。如果布伦特福德未能在周六晚些时候伦敦西部与默西塞德郡的另一场比赛中击败利物浦，一场胜利将使切尔西超越太妃糖，并有可能升至第四。利物浦（50 场）是切尔西唯一一场联赛客场失利多于埃弗顿（44 场，与阿森纳相同）的比赛。其中 43 场比赛是在古迪逊公园球场举行的，但三月在希尔迪金森体育场 3-0 的失利是蓝军自 1987 年 10 月 1-4 输给埃弗顿以来的最大失利，当时约翰·霍林斯担任主教练时运气不佳。截至目前，切尔西四次与太妃糖交锋保持不败，其中三场获胜。然而，若日尼奥在 2022 年 8 月的点球是我们在古迪逊公园球场的最后一个制胜球，结束了斯坦利公园那边的四连败。那里的第一场胜利是在 1908 年 4 月，由乔治·希尔斯顿 (George Hilsdon) 提供，“加特林机枪”当天取得了三场比赛没有回复。 1919 年 8 月 30 日，第一次世界大战后第一个赛季开始时，切尔西以 3-2 击败默西塞德郡，震惊战前卫冕冠军。三年后，蓝军重演了这一比分，但时隔 26 年，蓝军以 3-2 的另一场胜利将所有积分从古迪逊带回西伦敦，新星罗伊·本特利首开纪录。我们 21 年来唯一的一场胜利是 1956 年 10 月以 3-0 获胜（莱斯·斯塔布斯 (Les Stubbs) 攻入两球），但在 1969 年 3 月，艾伦·伯切纳尔 (Alan Birchenall) 和伊恩·哈钦森 (Ian Hutchinson) 的进球为戴夫·塞克斯顿 (Dave Sexton) 的国王之路国王队 (Kings of the King's Road) 赢得了战利品。 1984 年 12 月，新援戈登·戴维斯 (Gordon Davies) 上演帽子戏法，以 4-3 的比分战胜对手，而四年后，史蒂夫·克拉克 (Steve Clarke) 罕见的进球终结了这场比赛。同样的结果标志着蓝军首次在英超联赛中挑战古迪逊公园，罗伯特·弗莱克成为头条新闻。 2001年至2010年，切尔西各项赛事主客场对埃弗顿均保持不败。其中包括 2009 年足总杯决赛的胜利以及迪迪埃·德罗巴 (Didier Drogba) 在 2006 年 12 月以 3-2 获胜的精彩绝杀。2012 年新年前夕，弗兰克·兰帕德 (Frank Lampard) 梅开二度帮助球队 2-1 获胜，开启了我们有史以来最好的五次客场三连胜。其中一场是2014年8月那场混乱的6-3，迭戈·科斯塔梅开二度，另一场是2017年下半场21分钟内连进三球，以3-0获胜。2022年的1-0是切尔西此后唯一的成功。切尔西（50 次）和埃弗顿（44 次）是本赛季迄今为止英超联赛中犯规次数最少的。若昂·佩德罗迄今为止在英超联赛中 13 次射门，其中 5 次进球。蓝军的射门转化率在顶级联赛中排名第二（18.29%），仅次于曼城（19.28%）。埃弗顿是本赛季射门失误最多的球队（14 次），但其中只有一次进球。摩根·罗杰斯和科尔·帕尔默本赛季总共射门 24 次。 切尔西本赛季在联赛开场 7 分钟内就打进了 6 个进球，占总进球数的 40%。开场三分钟就打入四球，落后于蓝军在整个夺冠赛季创下的俱乐部纪录一球，距离曼联在 2010/11 赛季创下的六球英超纪录还差两球。在上周六5-1击败伯恩茅斯的比赛中，乔丹·亨德森（36岁零115天）成为自2017年5月约翰·特里对阵沃特福德（36岁零159天）以来切尔西最年长的英格兰进球者。在英超联赛中，唯一比亨德森对阵樱桃队的比赛（2分29秒）进球和助攻更快的球员是1998年4月对阵德比郡队的埃米尔·赫斯基，比赛开场两分钟内。

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea Gameweek seven
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：切尔西第七周比赛
news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which Blues player is the best value-for-money pick, why Joao Pedro (£7.8m) is Chelsea’s most popular player this week and who you should captain in Gameweek 7. After being transferred out by over 500,000 managers ahead of Gameweek 6 due to an injury flag, Joao Pedro quickly justified his status as the second most-selected player in FPL with his third double-digit haul in five starts. Following his brace and 12-point haul against Bournemouth, the Brazilian has risen in price and is over halfway to another rise ahead of Saturday’s deadline. Pedro is the most-bought forward of the Gameweek and the third most-bought player overall. Among Chelsea players, Pedro ranks first for big chances with five and shots on target with six. The Blues number-nine also leads the way for expected goals (xG) and sits second for expected goal involvement (xGI). Fellow Blues attackers,Rogers and Cole Palmer (£9.7m), also feature in the top-seven most bought players of the Gameweek with 280,000+ and 140,000+ buys, respectively. The former is closer to a price rise. Pedro Neto (£6.5m) picked up an assist against Bournemouth and started as the right wing-back for the fifth consecutive match. The Portugal international had two shots on goal and registered one key pass. While Neto isn’t as explosive as the front three, he is the cheapest Chelsea attacker to start regularly. The Chelsea number seven is also the biggest offensive differential available, currently sitting at just 1.4% of teams. The underlying data does provide some encouragement. Only Joao Pedro has had more big chances than Neto, while he has posted the most accurate crosses and passes into the penalty box of any Blues player. Unsurprisingly, Erling Haaland (£15.6m) is an obvious captaincy pick with Man City hosting newly-promoted Ipswich Town on Saturday. The Norwegian has scored in five consecutive league matches, returning nine bonus points in that time, as well as notching a brace against PSG in midweek. No player has had more shots in the box (21), while Haaland ranks second for big chances (10) among all positions. Opponents Ipswich have conceded the most xG (7.63) and big chances (15) of any team in away matches. For any managers yet to play the Triple Captain chip, it looks like a great opportunity to use the chip. Elsewhere, Maxim De Cuyper (£5.1m) is an intriguing, differential option against Crystal Palace. Despite being classified as a defender in FPL, De Cuyper has started all six matches out-of-position on the left-wing. The Belgian international notched a 15-point haul last time out thanks to a goal, clean sheet and maximum bonus points. He is averaging nearly nine points per match and faces Crystal Palace at home in GW7. No club has conceded more expected goals than the Eagles so far this season.
news.body_zh: 切尔西已与 Fantasy Football Scout 合作，帮助您在 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) 赛季期间为您提供提示、技巧和建议。球探将利用他们的专业知识提供建议和比赛周技巧，这对于确保您赢得迷你联赛很有用。在这里，我们来看看哪位蓝军球员是性价比最高的球员，为什么若昂·佩德罗（780万英镑）是切尔西本周最受欢迎的球员，以及在第七场比赛中你应该以谁为队长。在第六场比赛之前因伤病而被超过 500,000 名教练转会后，若昂·佩德罗很快证明了自己作为 FPL 中第二大入选球员的地位，这是他在五场首发中第三次获得两位数的成绩。在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中梅开二度并拿下 12 分后，这位巴西人的身价已经上涨，并且在周六截止日期之前将再次上涨。佩德罗是《游戏周》购买次数最多的前锋，也是整体购买次数第​​三多的球员。在切尔西球员中，佩德罗以五次绝佳机会和六次射门排名第一。蓝军第九名在预期进球数 (xG) 方面也领先，在预期进球参与度 (xGI) 方面排名第二。蓝军攻击手罗杰斯和科尔·帕尔默（970 万英镑）也以 280,000 以上和 140,000 以上的购买量跻身游戏周购买次数最多的球员前七名。前者更接近价格上涨。佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto，650万英镑）在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中助攻，并连续第五场比赛作为右翼卫首发。这位葡萄牙国脚有两次射门并完成一次关键传球。虽然内托的爆发力不如前三名，但他是切尔西首发最便宜的攻击手。排名第七的切尔西也是进攻差距最大的球队，目前仅占球队的 1.4%。基础数据确实提供了一些鼓励。只有若奥·佩德罗比内托拥有更多的绝佳机会，而他的传中和传球准确度是所有蓝军球员中最准确的。毫不奇怪，埃尔林·哈兰德（1560万英镑）显然是曼城周六主场迎战升班马伊普斯维奇的队长人选。挪威人已经连续五场联赛进球，期间拿下九分，并在周中对阵巴黎圣日耳曼的比赛中梅开二度。没有任何球员在禁区射门次数比他多（21次），而哈兰德的绝佳机会数（10次）在所有位置中排名第二。对手伊普斯维奇是客场比赛中失球次数最多的球队（7.63）和失球机会最多的球队（15）。对于任何尚未玩过三重队长芯片的经理来说，这似乎是使用该芯片的绝佳机会。在其他地方，马克西姆·德库珀（Maxim De Cuyper）（510万英镑）是对阵水晶宫的一个有趣的差异化选择。尽管在 FPL 中被归类为后卫，但德库珀在所有六场比赛中都在左翼位置上首发。这位比利时国脚在上一场比赛中凭借进球、不失球和最高奖励积分拿下了 15 分。他场均得分近九分，并在第七届世界杯主场迎战水晶宫。本赛季到目前为止，没有哪家具乐部比老鹰队的失球数更多。

news.body_en: Tottenham are the visitors to Stamford Bridge on Sunday lunchtime as Chelsea restart our Women's Super League campaign following the international break. news.body_en: A new documentary starring our brilliant Brazilian Estevao Willian is now available to watch exclusively on CFC+. I Am Estevao charts the unique journey of the 19-year-old from the city of Franca in south-east Brazil, through the Santos and Palmeiras youth systems, to arriving in London and that incredible goal against Barcelona. Estevao’s family and early coaches provide exclusive input, describing the young boy who would develop into the man we see in Blue today. Chelsea legends, including Thiago Silva and David Luiz, also provide their views on Estevao's journey so far. Estevao gives insight in the documentary into why he chose Chelsea, what it was like playing – and scoring – for Palmeiras against his future employers at the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup, and the words he exchanged with Cole Palmer after that game. ‘I believe it was a very important match in my life and that it will be marked in my history,’ says Estevao. ‘Playing against my future club was something amazing. After the game, I felt very well-received. 'I didn’t understand Palmer much! All I understood was ‘excited’, then someone came over who spoke Spanish or Portuguese, and that helped me a lot. He was my translator at the time! ‘So they were saying they were excited to see me, to welcome me at Chelsea, so I was very happy.’ In the documentary, now available exclusively on CFC+, Estevao also discusses his adaptation to English football and life at Stamford Bridge, and the emotion of his memorable goals against Liverpool and Barcelona is beautifully conveyed. You can get more information on CFC+ and subscribe here now. Beyond I Am Estevao, CFC+ brings you even more exclusive Chelsea content all year round, including: Every episode of CFC Unlocked, featuring in-depth conversations with the likes of Morgan Rogers, Cole Palmer and Reece James Live Cobham Next Gen and Chelsea Under-18s matches Selected live training sessions Iconic games from the archive, original series and boxsets throughout the season CFC+ is also included in our True Blue+ membership package, fresh for 2026/27. You can get more information on True Blue+ and become a member now!

news.body_en: This weekend’s trip to Merseyside will be Chelsea’s first match outside London in any competition this season, and here are all the facts and figures you need ahead of kick-off against Everton. It is our seventh game in the Premier League and we go into it in sixth place in the table, level on points with fourth-place Brentford and eight points behind leaders Manchester City. Everton are in fifth, with the same 10-point total as Chelsea, having recorded two wins and four draws so far. Chelsea are aiming to prevent Everton recording consecutive Premier League wins over us for the first time since 2019. The Toffees have won six of their past nine home Premier League matches against Chelsea (two draws, one defeat). We have not scored in seven of those games, including the last three. Chelsea have scored 305 goals against the Toffees in all competitions, 21 more than we have managed against any other side (next is Tottenham Hotspur, with 284). We lost 3-0 at Everton in the corresponding fixture in March, our first visit to their new Hill Dickinson Stadium. The Blues have conceded in each of our past 22 Premier League matches, our longest league run without a clean sheet since our club record 31-game sequence in the old First Division between November 1960 and August 1961. news.title: Chelsea supporters turn Denver blue at Premier League Mornings Live
news.title_zh: 切尔西球迷在英超早间直播中将丹佛变成蓝色
news.body_en: Rocky Mountain Blues took centre stage as Chelsea fans from across the United States gathered at Union Station for a memorable celebration of our global fanbase. Downtown Denver was filled with Chelsea blue as supporters came together for Premier League Mornings Live, a weekend showcasing the passion, energy and community that define following the club in the United States. Fans arrived early to watch Chelsea take on Bournemouth, and they were rewarded with an entertaining game packed with goals. From the first whistle, the Chelsea contingent made its presence felt, bringing colour and noise to Union Station and creating a matchday atmosphere thousands of miles from Stamford Bridge. Supporters travelled from across the United States, with many members of different Official Chelsea Supporters Clubs joining the celebrations. Among them were members from as far away as the Nepal Supporters Club. At the centre of the weekend was the Rocky Mountain Blues, Chelsea’s fantastic Denver-based official supporters club. Premier League Mornings Live provided the perfect platform to share more of their story: how the group has grown from strength to strength, welcomed new members and built a close-knit community around a shared love of Chelsea. The group showed exactly what makes supporter clubs so special. Ahead of the main event, the Rocky Mountain Blues hosted a meet-up at the British Bulldog, the group’s much-loved home in Denver. Members gather there every weekend, often in the earliest hours of the morning, to watch both Chelsea’s men’s and women’s teams as a group. Last weekend, the Rocky Mountain Blues were able to share their journey with a wider audience and show how the group has grown from strength to strength. For every Chelsea fan in attendance, it was another reminder that, no matter the distance from London, Blues fans are never far from home with the global Official Supporters Club programme. news.title: OTD: Blues put five past Bolton
news.title_zh: OTD：蓝军五场击败博尔顿
news.body_en: On 15 October 2005, Chelsea roared back from a goal down to defeat Bolton 5-1 at Stamford Bridge with a clinic of attacking football. Jose Mourinho’s defending champions had started the season flawlessly, winning eight league games on the spin, including a 4-1 thrashing of Liverpool at Anfield. The visit of Bolton evoked memories of our most recent meeting with the Trotters, a few months prior. On that occasion victory secured us our maiden Premier League title – this win at the Bridge cemented our place at the top of the table. It was a position we would not let slip. So it was a shock when Stelios Giannakopoulos side-footed Bolton ahead with just four minutes on the clock. We were fortunate not to go two behind when Gary Speed thundered a half-volley against the crossbar, while Giannakopoulos was thwarted by Ricardo Carvalho. The introduction of former Bolton player Eidur Gudjohnsen for Asier del Horno at half-time helped swing the contest in our favour. ‘It was a question of bringing something different in tactical terms and what the opponent would not be ready for,’ said Mourinho. Within ten minutes of the restart, we had turned the game around through goals from Didier Drogba and Frank Lampard. After Ricardo Gardner was dismissed for deliberate handball, Lampard took advantage of a poorly-constructed wall to put us 3-1 up. Drogba acrobatically flashed in a fourth before Gudjohnsen sealed an emphatic success with a typically cool one-on-one finish. We did finally drop points in our next fixture, at Everton, but there was no stopping us winning back-to-back titles come the spring.
news.body_zh: 2005年10月15日，切尔西在斯坦福桥球场以攻势足球的方式在落后的情况下奋起反击，以5-1击败博尔顿。穆里尼奥的卫冕冠军在本赛季开局完美，赢得了八场联赛，其中包括在安菲尔德4-1击败利物浦。博尔顿的来访让我们想起了几个月前我们最近一次与 Trotters 的会面。那一次的胜利为我们赢得了第一个英超冠军——这场在桥上的胜利巩固了我们在积分榜上的地位。我们不会放弃这一立场。因此，当斯特利奥斯·詹纳科普洛斯在比赛还剩四分钟时侧脚帮助博尔顿领先时，人们感到震惊。当加里·斯皮德（Gary Speed）的半截射击中横梁时，我们很幸运没有落后两分，而詹纳科普洛斯（Giannakopoulos）则被里卡多·卡瓦略（Ricardo Carvalho）挡出。半场结束时，前博尔顿球员埃杜尔·古德约翰森换上阿西尔·德尔·奥尔诺，帮助我们扭转了比赛的局面。穆里尼奥说：“问题是在战术方面带来一些不同的东西，以及对手没有准备好的东西。”比赛重新开始后十分钟内，我们凭借迪迪埃·德罗巴和弗兰克·兰帕德的进球扭转了比赛局面。里卡多·加德纳因故意手球被罚下场后，兰帕德利用人墙结构不佳的优势帮助我们3-1领先。德罗巴在第四节中表现得如杂技般，随后古德约翰森以典型的冷静一对一射门取得了巨大的成功。我们最终在下一场对阵埃弗顿的比赛中丢了分，但这并没有阻止我们在春天赢得背靠背冠军。

news.title: Katie McCabe on why her move to Chelsea has been a 'breath of fresh air'
news.title_zh: 凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 谈为何转会切尔西让她“呼吸到了新鲜空气”
news.body_en: Katie McCabe says she’s ‘enjoying her football again’ after her summer transfer to Chelsea. The left-back was speaking in her captain’s role for the Republic of Ireland after she scored in a 5-0 win over Kazakhstan on Tuesday, a result that sent her nation through to the second round of the 2027 Women’s World Cup play-offs with a 12-0 aggregate win. While her focus on the night was purely on her country, she gave a glimpse into life at her new club to give some context to her excellent form. ‘The move for me has been a breath of fresh air,’ she said. ‘It was time for me to start a new chapter. Ever since I’ve come in to work with Chelsea and Sonia (Bompastor) and the girls, it’s been brilliant. We’ve had a fantastic start to the season. ‘The role is a little bit different, but I’m loving learning all the new things from a new coach. I’m playing with world-class players, and I’m really enjoying it. ‘I’m enjoying my football again and just taking it game by game. There are so many games, but for me personally, what’s most important now is to be in the best position to qualify for a World Cup.’ McCabe captained Ireland to qualify for their first World Cup in Australia and New Zealand in 2023. The side will now face a two-legged tie against Poland to decide whether or not they will qualify for a second consecutive World Cup this summer in Brazil. Carla Ward's side have already beaten Poland twice in qualifying –  a side with Barcelona’s Ewa Pajor among their squad – but things have not all been plain sailing. February’s 4-0 loss against Slovenia in Women’s Nations League action was compounded by another 1-0 defeat to the same opponent in June, and McCabe doesn’t want the team to take anything for granted. ‘We've put ourselves in a really good position,' continued McCabe. 'The opponents we've faced, top ten opponents, the girls have done brilliantly. Since Carla came in, it's been a transition period, and it’s taken a bit of time to find our feet. ‘We learnt our lesson with that heavy defeat by Slovenia, and we've built and grown. We've tried to gather as much momentum as possible. We've had some highs and lows over the years. It's going to be really important, and we'll stick together going into November. ‘We'll be doing everything we can to get over the line and get this country to the World Cup again. For us, we've played them recently, and it's going to be different come November. We know there's a World Cup place at stake, so we need to be ready. It's an exciting one.’ Don't miss Katie in action against our London derby rivals Spurs at the Bridge this Sunday! Get your tickets here...
news.body_zh: 凯蒂·麦凯布表示，在夏季转会到切尔西后，她“再次享受足球的乐趣”。周二，这位左后卫在爱尔兰共和国5-0战胜哈萨克斯坦的比赛中攻入一球，帮助爱尔兰队以总比分12-0晋级2027年女足世界杯附加赛第二轮。虽然她当晚的注意力完全集中在她的国家，但她也瞥见了新俱乐部的生活，为她出色的状态提供了一些背景。 “这次搬迁对我来说是呼吸新鲜空气，”她说。 “现在是我开始新篇章的时候了。自从我开始与切尔西、索尼娅（邦帕斯特）和女孩们一起工作以来，一切都很棒。我们这个赛季有一个美妙的开局。 “这个角色有点不同，但我喜欢从新教练那里学习所有新东西。我正在和世界级的球员一起比赛，我真的很享受。 “我又开始享受我的足球了，并且一场一场地踢球。比赛有很多，但对我个人来说，现在最重要的是处于获得世界杯参赛资格的最佳位置。麦凯布带领爱尔兰首次获得 2023 年澳大利亚和新西兰世界杯的参赛资格。球队现在将与波兰进行两回合比赛，以决定他们是否能够连续第二次参加今年夏天在巴西举行的世界杯。卡拉·沃德的球队已经在预选赛中两次击败波兰队——巴塞罗那队的埃瓦·帕约尔也在其中——但事情并非一帆风顺。 2 月在女子国家联赛中 0-4 负于斯洛文尼亚，而 6 月又以 1-0 负于同一对手，麦凯布不希望球队认为任何事情都是理所当然的。 “我们已经把自己置于一个非常有利的位置，”麦凯布继续说道。 “我们面对的对手，排名前十的对手，女孩们都表现得很出色。自从卡拉加入以来，这是一个过渡期，我们花了一些时间才能站稳脚跟。 “我们从斯洛文尼亚的惨败中吸取了教训，我们已经建立并成长了。我们试图聚集尽可能多的动力。这些年来我们经历过一些高潮和低谷。这将非常重要，我们将在十一月份团结一致。 “我们将尽一切努力来克服困难，让这个国家再次进入世界杯。对我们来说，我们最近已经打过这些比赛，到了 11 月份情况将会有所不同。我们知道世界杯席位岌岌可危，所以我们需要做好准备。这是一场令人兴奋的比赛。”不要错过本周日在桥上对阵我们的伦敦德比对手热刺队的凯蒂的比赛！在这里获取门票...

news.title: Lexi Potter: My journey to Chelsea
news.title_zh: 莱克西·波特：我的切尔西之旅
news.body_en: On Tuesday night, Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter made her first senior appearance for England, starting in midfield alongside her Blues team-mate Keira Walsh. Handed Legacy Number 244 ahead of kick-off, the 20-year-old then helped the Lionesses to a 5-0 win in the Women's World Cup play-off against Greece at Leicester's King Power Stadium. It was an ideal way for her to begin what looks set to be a long career with England. We spoke to Lexi about her journey to becoming a Chelsea player in March. By the end of that season, she had made four starts and ten substitute appearances, scoring her maiden goal for the Blues in a 2-1 win over Brighton & Hove Albion. This season, our head coach Sonia Bompastor has explained that Potter has now cemented her place in the Blues first team. She has made five starts and two appearances from the bench in our opening nine games of the campaign, a run of form that has made it impossible for England's Sarina Wiegman to ignore. Here is where we began our homegrown star's story back in March... The young midfielder is still relatively new to conducting interviews, but her enthusiasm shines through nonetheless. When the topic of football is introduced, she immediately lights up, and it’s evident she is living out her dream here at Chelsea. ‘Football means everything to me,’ she smiles. ‘It's always been football, football, football. I was never really interested in school. I just wanted to come home, get my kit on and go to training. Ever since I was a young girl, it's been the biggest part of my life.’ Potter was born in Epsom, but has lived in Redhill since the age of three. She described an area that has everything she needs close by, including Chelsea’s Cobham training ground. Her upbringing has provided the platform for her football career to blossom. She beams when she talks about her family and explains how their dedication to her passion from a young age helped her succeed. ‘My dad is from Essex, and my mum is from Banstead,’ she explains. ‘My mum works at a primary school and I went to the same school when I was younger. My dad works from home so he's there a lot with the dog. He's never left alone…the dog, I mean! ‘I've been really lucky with the support that I've had. My mum spent a lot of time taking me to football and my grandparents live quite locally, so my brother would spend time with them when my mum was out taking me places. My family was very supportive and encouraging. ‘My earliest football memory was playing with my brother and his friends in the local boys' football team. Just playing with my brother, having fun. We're close in age, he was the year above me at school, so I wanted to do everything he did. ‘I went to Saint Bede’s School in Redhill. I played for the boys' team there - we didn't really have a girls' team. After school, I played out with my brother.' It’s not only natural talent that has made Potter stand out above other players of the same age. A look at her performances in the first team this season shows she has all the attributes to become an elite midfielder: sharp passing, good decision-making, close control and the physicality to hold off opponents while shielding the ball. The conversation moves on, and it immediately becomes clear how she has managed to develop those attributes at such a young age. Playing futsal on a small indoor pitch against boys opened the door to her becoming one of England’s best young talents in the centre of the park. ‘I played futsal for a long time when I was growing up with my brother,’ explains Potter. ‘It's indoors, so it's quite tight, confined spaces. You had to learn to be good on the ball technically and try to get out of these tight spaces. It was about close control and the importance of the basics. ‘We played together when we were younger, before it became really physical. For me, it was important to play with boys because they can help shape you as a player. You have to move the ball more quickly. ‘You have to react quicker, you have to be smart and know what you want to do with the ball before you get it, because of how quick and agile they can be. You have to make those decisions faster. ‘Boys are a lot more physical and aggressive, so I feel like playing with them has helped me to become the player I am today.’ Having signed for the Chelsea academy at eight years old, Potter has grown up in an environment designed to help keep her feet on the ground – and it shows. Her two-year loan spell at Crystal Palace between 2023 and 2025 allowed her to compete against experienced professionals, and now she is continuing her development in the Chelsea first team. ‘I’ve never really thought to myself that I’m good,’ she says. ‘It’s more a feeling of being humble and wanting to work hard to be the best I can be. But in the Academy, we had a good team, and I had really good players around me. We won the FA Cup together. ‘Being at the Chelsea Academy was so good for me. Some brilliant staff members helped me along the way, and I was surrounded by great players at my age. Then I went on loan to Palace. We won the Women’s Championship, and then I had the opportunity to play in the WSL the following season. ‘It was a bit difficult for me when I first went there, though. It was a women's team, so I had to grow up really quickly from the academy in terms of needing to be independent and stuff. I had been at Chelsea my whole life, but then I had to adapt to a new atmosphere and try to break into an established team. And as footballers, all we want to do is to be playing. ‘All the sacrifices are worth it to be able to play for Chelsea and to be able to play with world-class players here. It’s something you dream of when you are young and hope to be able to do. But I know I've got a long way to go still. ‘I try not to get distracted by others because everyone's journey is different, so I concentrate on myself. I want to keep learning every day, take good advice, give it my all and have no regrets. ‘Now I’m back at Chelsea, training every single day with the first team. I love working in such a high-performance atmosphere and being a part of a squad who are always competing for trophies. It’s amazing to be learning from the best.’
news.body_zh: 周二晚上，切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特首次代表英格兰国家队出场，与她的蓝军队友凯拉·沃尔什一起在中场首发。这位20岁的球员在开球前将球衣号码交给了Legacy 244，随后帮助狮队在莱斯特王权球场举行的女足世界杯附加赛中以5-0战胜希腊队。对于她来说，这是开始在英格兰度过漫长职业生涯的理想方式。我们在三月份采访了莱克西，讲述了她成为切尔西球员的历程。到那个赛季结束时，她已经首发四次，替补出场十次，并在蓝军2-1战胜布莱顿的比赛中打进了她的处子球。本赛季，我们的主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释说，波特现在已经巩固了她在蓝军一线队的地位。在本赛季的前九场比赛中，她首发五次，替补出场两次，这种状态让英格兰队的萨琳娜·维格曼无法忽视。这是我们三月份开始讲述我们本土球星的故事的地方……这位年轻的中场球员在接受采访方面还相对较新，但她的热情仍然闪耀着。当谈到足球这个话题时，她立刻就兴奋起来，很明显她正在切尔西实现自己的梦想。 “足球对我来说意味着一切，”她微笑着说。 “一直都是足球、足球、足球。我对学校从来没有真正的兴趣。我只想回家，穿上我的装备去参加训练。从我还是个小女孩的时候起，这就是我生命中最重要的部分。”波特出生在埃普索姆，但从三岁起就住在红山。她描述了一个附近有她需要的一切的区域，包括切尔西的科巴姆训练场。她的成长经历为她的足球生涯提供了蓬勃发展的平台。当她谈到她的家庭并解释他们从小就对她的热情的奉献如何帮助她取得成功时，她笑容满面。 “我的父亲来自埃塞克斯，我的母亲来自班斯特德，”她解释道。 “我妈妈在一所小学工作，我小时候也上过同一所学校。我爸爸在家工作，所以他经常带着狗。他从来没有孤单过……我是说，那只狗！ “我真的很幸运能得到大家的支持。我妈妈花了很多时间带我去踢足球，而我的祖父母住在当地，所以当我妈妈出去带我去的时候，我哥哥会花时间和他们在一起。我的家人非常支持和鼓励我。 “我最早的足球记忆是与我的兄弟和他的朋友在当地男子足球队踢球。和弟弟一起玩，玩得很开心。我们年龄相近，他在学校比我高一年级，所以我想做他所做的一切。 “我去了红山的圣贝德学校。我在那里为男孩队效力——我们并没有真正的女孩队。放学后，我和弟弟一起出去玩。”让波特在同龄球员中脱颖而出的不仅仅是天赋。从她本赛季在一线队的表现来看，她具备成为一名精英中场球员的所有特质：敏锐的传球、良好的决策、严密的控制以及在护球的同时阻挡对手的身体素质。谈话继续进行，我们很快就明白了她是如何在如此年轻的时候培养出这些品质的。在一个小型室内球场上与男孩们踢五人制足球为她成为英格兰公园中心最优秀的年轻天才之一打开了大门。 “当我和哥哥一起长大时，我玩了很长时间的五人制足球，”波特解释道。 “这是在室内，所以空间非常狭窄。你必须学会​​在技术上擅长控球，并尝试摆脱这些狭窄的空间。这是关于密切控制和基础知识的重要性。 “我们年轻的时候就一起踢球，当时还没有真正开始身体对抗。对我来说，和男孩一起打球很重要，因为他们可以帮助你塑造一名球员。你必须更快地移动球。 “你必须反应更快，你必须聪明，在接球之前就知道你想用球做什么，因为他们的速度和敏捷性非常高。您必须更快地做出这些决定。 “男孩们的身体素质和攻击性都更强，所以我觉得和他们一起踢球帮助我成为了今天的我。”八岁时与切尔西青训学院签约，波特在一个旨在帮助她脚踏实地的环境中长大——这一点也表明了这一点。 2023 年至 2025 年间，她租借到水晶宫两年，这使她能够与经验丰富的专业人士竞争，现在她正在切尔西一线队继续发展。 “我从来没有真正认为自己很好，”她说。 “这更多的是一种谦虚的感觉，以及想要努力做到最好的感觉。但在青训学院，我们有一支优秀的团队，我周围也有非常优秀的球员。我们一起赢得了足总杯。 “在切尔西青训学院对我来说非常好。一路上，一些出色的工作人员为我提供了帮助，在我这个年纪，我周围都是伟大的球员。然后我被租借到皇宫。我们赢得了女子冠军，然后我就有机会在接下来的赛季参加 WSL。 “不过，当我第一次去那里时，这对我来说有点困难。这是一支女子球队，所以我必须在需要独立等方面从学院很快成长起来。我一生都在切尔西，但后来我必须适应新的氛围并尝试融入一支老牌球队。作为足球运动员，我们想做的就是踢球。 “为了能够为切尔西效力并能够在这里与世界级球员一起踢球，所有的牺牲都是值得的。这是你年轻时梦想并希望能够做到的事情。但我知道我还有很长的路要走。 “我尽量不被别人分心，因为每个人的旅程都不同，所以我专注于自己。我想每天继续学习，接受好的建议，全力以赴，不留遗憾。 “现在我回到了切尔西，每天都和一线队一起训练。我喜欢在如此高绩效的氛围中工作，并成为一支总是争夺奖杯的球队的一员。向最优秀的人学习真是太棒了。”

news.title: Chelsea’s 10 oldest Premier League scorers
news.title_zh: 切尔西最年长的 10 位英超进球者
news.body_en: Having found the net twice in our win against Bournemouth, Jordan Henderson became one of the oldest goalscorers in our history. Here we look at the top ten such players to have found the net for Chelsea in the Premier League era. Henderson's brilliant brace was some way for him to announce himself to the Stamford Bridge faithful, and put him in distinguished company in our history. Some of the very greatest to have worn the blue shirt – Frank Lampard, Thiago Silva, Didier Drogba and co – found the net late in their Blues careers, and here we look back at our top ten league goalscorers since 1992... The Rock chose a fantastic moment to score his final goal for us: a header to equalise against Liverpool in May 2003 in a game we had to avoid losing to secure Champions League football – and with it the club’s future. The first of two player-managers on this list, Luca scored in his last game before hanging up his boots. It was a trademark control and volley against Derby County in May 1999. Super Frank’s 211th and final Chelsea goal was a rebound from a penalty saved by future Blue Asmir Begovic as we comfortably defeated Stoke City at Stamford Bridge in April 2014. Henderson marked his Stamford Bridge debut in style, scoring two brilliant long-range goals in our 5-1 win against Bournemouth. Hoddle’s solitary Chelsea goal was a neat touch and finish to put the seal on a 2-0 home win against West Ham United in March 1994. JT’s penultimate game for us yielded his final goal. The opponents at the Bridge in May 2017 were Watford, the goal a well-taken one from inside the six-yard box during a 4-3 victory. In a topsy-turvy London derby against Tottenham in February 1994, Donaghy fired in at the near post to reduce the arrears to 2-1 in a classic we would eventually go on to win 4-3. Gianfranco brought the goalscoring curtain down in Chelsea blue in typically spectacular fashion, cleverly lobbing Everton goalkeeper Richard Wright from close to the touchline. Drogba’s 164th and final goal for us was a smart finish away to Leicester City in April 2015 as we closed in on the Premier League title under Jose Mourinho. Thiago Silva’s perfectly directed header past his compatriot Ederson, of Man City, meant the brilliant Brazilian surpassed Dick Spence as our oldest scorer in November 2023. Spence was 38 years and 282 days old when he scored away to Wolves back on 26 April 1947. There was still time for Thiago to extend that record, with his final Blues goal against Sheffield United in April 2024 coming when he was 39 years and 198 days old. It will take some beating!
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森在我们战胜伯恩茅斯的比赛中两次进球，成为我们历史上最年长的进球者之一。下面我们来看看英超时代为切尔西进球的前十名球员。亨德森的精彩梅开二度在某种程度上让他向斯坦福桥的忠实球迷宣告了自己，并让他成为了我们历史上的杰出人物。一些最伟大的蓝色球衣球员——弗兰克·兰帕德、蒂亚戈·席尔瓦、迪迪埃·德罗巴等——在他们的蓝军职业生涯后期都取得了进球，在这里我们回顾一下自 1992 年以来的十大联赛射手……这位巨石选择了一个绝佳的时刻为我们打进了他的最后一个进球：2003 年 5 月对阵利物浦的头球扳平比分，在这场比赛中，我们必须避免失利，以确保欧冠资格，也确保了俱乐部的未来。卢卡是这份名单上的两位球员兼教练中的第一位，他在挂靴前的最后一场比赛中进球。这是 1999 年 5 月对阵德比郡的标志性控球和凌空抽射。2014 年 4 月，我们在斯坦福桥轻松击败斯托克城，超级弗兰克在切尔西的第 211 个也是最后一个进球是从未来的蓝军阿斯米尔·贝戈维奇扑出的点球中反弹。亨德森以风格完成了他在斯坦福桥的处子秀，在我们 5-1 战胜伯恩茅斯的比赛中打进了两个精彩的远射进球。 1994 年 3 月，霍德尔在切尔西队的唯一进球是一次漂亮的射门，帮助球队主场 2-0 战胜西汉姆联队。JT 为我们队倒数第二场比赛打进了他的最后一个进球。 2017 年 5 月，蓝桥的对手是沃特福德，进球是在 6 码禁区内漂亮射门，最终以 4-3 获胜。 1994 年 2 月，在一场混乱的伦敦德比战托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中，多纳吉近门柱射门，将落后的比分缩小到 2-1，这场经典比赛最终让我们以 4-3 获胜。身着切尔西蓝球衣的吉安弗兰科以典型的壮观方式拉开了进球帷幕，他巧妙地在边线附近吊射埃弗顿门将理查德·赖特。德罗巴为我们打进的第 164 个进球，也是最后一个进球，是 2015 年 4 月客场对阵莱斯特城的精彩进球，帮助我们在穆里尼奥的带领下锁定了英超冠军。蒂亚戈·席尔瓦完美的头球攻破了他的同胞曼城的埃德森，这意味着这位才华横溢的巴西人在 2023 年 11 月超越了迪克·斯彭斯，成为我们最年长的进球者。1947 年 4 月 26 日客场对阵狼队的比赛中，斯彭斯进球时，他已经 38 岁零 282 天。蒂亚戈还有时间延续这一纪录，2024 年 4 月对阵谢菲尔德联队时，他在蓝军的最后一个进球是在 39 岁的时候完成的。 198天了。这将需要一些打击！

news.title: OTD: John Terry goes in goal!
news.title_zh: OTD：约翰·特里进球了！
news.body_en: It is not often you see an outfielder have to take the goalkeeper gloves but that is exactly what John Terry did at Reading 20 years ago today. Our first league visit to the Madejski Stadium to play the newly-promoted Royals was a frenzied affair from the off. Inside a minute, Petr Cech suffered a serious head injury that threatened his life. Thankfully, after surgery on his skull, the goalkeeper was able to make a full recovery. He was back between our posts just a few months later. Back to Berkshire, and Frank Lampard put us ahead with a deflected free-kick on the stroke of half-time. The battle continued in the second half as both sides were reduced to ten men, before Cudicini - who had replaced Cech early on - was knocked unconscious after being clattered into by Ibrahima Sonko while collecting a corner. With a few minutes still to play, captain Terry took the shirt of third-choice keeper Hilario and headed between the posts as the nine-man Blues saw out a gritty 1-0 win. JT didn't have too much to do, thankfully, but you can see still him in action in this unfamiliar role below.
news.body_zh: 你很少会看到外野手必须接过守门员手套，但这正是约翰·特里20年前的今天在雷丁所做的。我们第一次在联赛中造访马德伊斯基球场，对阵升班马皇家队，从一开始就是一场疯狂的比赛。一分钟之内，切赫头部严重受伤，危及生命。值得庆幸的是，在颅骨手术后，守门员能够完全康复。几个月后，他又回到了我们的岗位。回到伯克郡，弗兰克·兰帕德在半场结束时射出一脚偏出的任意球，帮助我们取得领先。下半场双方的战斗仍在继续，双方都只剩下十人，而早早替换切赫的库迪奇尼在获得角球时被易卜拉希马·松科撞倒昏迷。比赛还剩几分钟时，队长特里接过第三门将希拉里奥的球衣，头球攻门，由九人组成的蓝军以 1-0 险胜。值得庆幸的是，JT 没有太多事情要做，但您仍然可以在下面看到他在这个陌生角色中的表演。

news.title: Moises Caicedo interview: I want to keep improving at ‘my home’ Chelsea
news.title_zh: 莫伊塞斯·凯塞多采访：我想在“我的家”切尔西不断进步
news.body_en: In an exclusive interview with Moises Caicedo, the Ecuadorian reflects on his journey at the Bridge, his bond with Blues supporters, and why he’s hungrier than ever for success… It is a testament to Moises Caicedo’s durability and consistency that his spell on the sidelines at the start of this season was his first absence of any note during his Chelsea career, which began more than three years ago now. That Caicedo never shirks a challenge in the heart of the midfield battle only makes that fact more impressive. He has won possession on more occasions than anyone else in the Premier League since the start of 2023/24, when he arrived at the Bridge, and only two players have made more tackles and interceptions in that time. Now, Caicedo’s back. Against Bournemouth on Saturday, it was like the Ecuadorian had never been away. Within 35 seconds of kick-off, he skilfully collected a bouncing ball, turned away from his man and drew a foul. Then came a forward pass to Cole Palmer, who darted into Bournemouth territory before teeing up Jordan Henderson to open the scoring. The replays of that fabulous strike had barely stopped showing when Caicedo won a tackle on the edge of the Bournemouth box, robbing Ryan Christie. The loose ball was worked to Morgan Rogers, who doubled our lead. Caicedo was withdrawn on 72 minutes – shortly after we had gone 5-1 up – to a standing ovation. No player had won more tackles or had a higher pass completion rate. His performance encapsulated the overwhelmingly positive impact he has had since joining Chelsea. And as he sits down with us at Cobham to reflect on his time at the Bridge so far, Caicedo tells us it has been a period of continuous growth, lessons learned and obstacles hurdled. His nature dictates it cannot stop now. ‘It has been a great journey for me, more than three special years at one of the best clubs in the world,’ Caicedo says. ‘In my first season, I passed some tough moments, I would say. They helped me to grow, to keep developing, and to be in the position I am in right now. I can look back and say it’s a pleasure for what I passed. ‘Now I’m just enjoying trying to do everything for this club, because they gave me everything. They helped me in every way, and I’ve grown up a lot because of them. I have more experience now, I’m more mature, and I just want to keep learning and keep doing what I’m doing. ‘I feel very grateful to Chelsea, and I want to keep showing the fans and everybody at the club what I am capable of.’ On the pitch, Caicedo is always in the thick of the action. No games pass him by, that’s for sure. Away from the grass, though, the 24-year-old is an unassuming character, softly spoken and kind. He prefers to set a good example with the way he plays, although he knows, as a member of the leadership group at Cobham, he has greater responsibility to make himself heard. ‘I think every coach tells me that I can improve talking on the pitch, you know? Because they know that I'm a leader, but it will be better for me if I start talking more with the players. I try my best, but it’s not in my nature. So when I'm not able to talk, I just try to show even more. ‘You learn from the previous ones, like Thiago Silva,’ Moises adds. ‘He was an example for us. He tried to help us in every moment. How he was a leader here was amazing for all of us. Now being one of the captains is a pleasure for me, and a special feeling for my family. Even if I’m not a player who likes to talk a lot, I like to show through what I do, so others can see my example.’ Xabi Alonso has said he has a ‘soft spot’ for our midfielders, because that was his position, and our manager has already described Caicedo as ‘one of the best holding players in the world’. Comments like those serve as motivation, the Ecuadorian explains. ‘With Xabi I am going to keep developing, for sure, and show him why he trusts me.’ There has been plenty of change during Caicedo’s time at the Bridge, but the support he has received from Chelsea fans, at home and abroad, has been a constant. He has observed the Blues’ popularity expand in his native Ecuador, and that relationship was cemented recently when the club completed the renovation of a community football pitch in Guayaquil, a port city in the west of the country. ‘It was a proud moment for me because Chelsea are doing things in Ecuador and I think I opened that door for them to go,’ says Caicedo. ‘The fans in Ecuador and at Stamford Bridge support me so much. Every game I see people from Ecuador in the stadium. And it’s an amazing feeling when the Chelsea fans sing my song. ‘They have been incredible with me. I just want to show them my best every single week because they like going to the game at the weekend and being happy and enjoying it. This is why we work in training every day, because they are on our minds and they deserve good things.’ So, too, does Caicedo. His achievements at Chelsea so far have included collective and individual accolades, but world-class levels of performance merit more, and he says he is feeling confident of winning silverware under Alonso’s guidance. Whatever happens, it has been a wonderful journey up until this point, a journey Caicedo reflects on with pride and renewed purpose. ‘I can say Chelsea is my home, because they treat me like I've been here for a long, long time,’ he smiles. ‘It’s a special place for me. 'I want to always give them happiness because I know they did everything for me. Everybody here, from the kitman to the coach, is a kind person to me. ‘The only thing I can say is that I want to always be the same, but even more so on the pitch. I want to always show my team-mates, the coaches, the fans, just what I'm capable of.’ That is a mantra we have no doubt Caicedo will continue to live by.
news.body_zh: 在接受莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的独家采访时，厄瓜多尔人回顾了他在蓝桥的旅程、他与蓝军球迷的联系，以及为什么他比以往任何时候都更渴望成功……这证明了莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的持久性和稳定性，他在本赛季开始时在场边的表现是他在切尔西职业生涯中的第一次缺席，而他的切尔西生涯已经开始了三年多了。凯塞多在中场核心的战斗中从不回避挑战，这只会让这一事实更加令人印象深刻。自2023/24年初抵达蓝桥以来，他在英超联赛中赢得控球的次数比其他任何人都多，而同期只有两名球员的铲球和拦截次数比他多。现在，凯塞多回来了。周六对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中，厄瓜多尔人就像​​从未离开过一样。开球后 35 秒内，他巧妙地接住了一个弹跳的球，转身背对防守球员，并造成了犯规。然后，科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 向前传球，后者冲入伯恩茅斯领地，然后为乔丹·亨德森 (Jordan Henderson) 首开纪录。当凯塞多在伯恩茅斯禁区边缘抢断瑞安·克里斯蒂的铲球时，那记精彩进球的重播刚刚停止。摩根·罗杰斯（Morgan Rogers）将球传给了他，他将我们的领先优势扩大了一倍。凯塞多在第 72 分钟时被撤下——就在我们 5-1 领先之后不久——全场起立鼓掌。没有任何球员赢得更多铲断或传球完成率更高。他的表现体现了他加盟切尔西以来所产生的极其积极的影响。当凯塞多在科巴姆与我们坐下来回顾他迄今为止在蓝桥的时光时，他告诉我们这是一个不断成长、吸取教训和克服障碍的时期。他的本性决定了现在不能停下来。 “这对我来说是一段伟大的旅程，在世界上最好的俱乐部之一度过了三年多的特殊岁月，”凯塞多说。 “我想说，在我的第一个赛季，我经历了一些艰难的时刻。他们帮助我成长，帮助我不断发展，并帮助我达到现在的位置。我可以回顾过去，对我所经历的一切感到高兴。 “现在我很享受为这个俱乐部做一切，因为他们给了我一切。他们在各方面帮助了我，我也因为他们而成长了很多。我现在有了更多的经验，我更加成熟，我只想继续学习，继续做我正在做的事情。 “我非常感谢切尔西，我想继续向球迷和俱乐部的每个人展示我的能力。” 在球场上，凯塞多总是处于最激烈的状态。没有比赛能超越他，这是肯定的。不过，远离草地后，这位 24 岁的年轻人性格谦逊，说话轻声细语，心地善良。他更喜欢用自己的比赛方式树立一个好榜样，尽管他知道，作为科巴姆领导小组的成员，他有更大的责任让自己的声音被听到。 “我想每个教练都告诉我，我可以提高在球场上的演讲能力，你知道吗？因为他们知道我是一名领导者，但如果我开始更多地与球员交谈，这对我来说会更好。我尽力而为，但这不是我的本性。所以当我无法说话时，我只是尝试展示更多。 “你可以向以前的人学习，比如蒂亚戈·席尔瓦，”莫伊塞斯补充道。 “他是我们的榜样。他每时每刻都试图帮助我们。他如何成为这里的领导者对我们所有人来说都是令人惊奇的。现在成为队长之一对我来说是一种荣幸，对我的家人来说也是一种特殊的感觉。即使我不是一个喜欢说话的球员，我也喜欢通过我所做的事情来展示，这样其他人就能看到我的榜样。”哈维·阿隆索曾说过，他对我们的中场球员“情有独钟”，因为那是他的位置，我们的主教练已经将凯塞多描述为“世界上最好的控球球员之一”。厄瓜多尔人解释说，类似的评论可以起到激励作用。 “在哈维的带领下，我肯定会继续进步，并向他展示为什么他信任我。”凯塞多在蓝桥期间发生了很多变化，但他从国内外切尔西球迷那里得到的支持却始终如一。他观察到蓝军在他的祖国厄瓜多尔的受欢迎程度不断扩大，最近俱乐部完成了该国西部港口城市瓜亚基尔社区足球场的翻修工程，这种关系得到了巩固。 “这对我来说是一个值得骄傲的时刻，因为切尔西正在厄瓜多尔做事，我想我为他们打开了大门，”凯塞多说。 “厄瓜多尔和斯坦福桥的球迷非常支持我。每场比赛我都会在体育场里看到来自厄瓜多尔的人。当切尔西球迷唱我的歌时，感觉很奇妙。 “他们对我来说非常棒。我只想每周向他们展示我最好的一面，因为他们喜欢在周末去看比赛，并快乐地享受比赛。这就是为什么我们每天都在训练中，因为我们关心他们，他们应该得到好的东西。”凯塞多也是如此。迄今为止，他在切尔西取得的成就包括集体和个人荣誉，但世界级的表现水平更值得，他说他有信心在阿隆索的指导下赢得奖杯。无论发生什么，到目前为止，这都是一段美妙的旅程，凯塞多带着自豪和新的目标回顾这段旅程。 “我可以说切尔西是我的家，因为他们对待我就像我已经在这里待了很长时间一样，”他微笑着说道。 “这对我来说是一个特别的地方。 “我想永远给他们幸福，因为我知道他们为我做了一切。这里的每个人，从装备工到教练，对我来说都是友善的人。 “我唯一能说的是，我希望永远保持不变，但在球场上更是如此。我想永远向我的队友、教练、球迷展示我的能力。”我们毫不怀疑凯塞多将继续恪守这一口号。

news.title: Internationals: James, Bjorn and McCabe net as Potter debuts
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：波特首秀，詹姆斯、比约恩和麦凯布入网
news.body_en: It was an excellent evening for several Chelsea players on international duty as their hopes of playing at the 2027 Women’s World Cup remained alive. There were victories across the board in European qualifiers for next summer’s tournament in Brazil, with those involved now turning their attention to next month’s second and final round of play-offs. At the King Power Stadium, Lauren James netted two first-half goals and Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter debuted for the Lionesses as England made light work of Greece, winning 5-0 on the night and 8-1 on aggregate. Potter lined up alongside Keira Walsh in the centre of England’s midfield, reprising the partnership that have proven so effective this season. Hannah Hampton started in goal while James was deployed in the no.10 position behind Alessio Russo. It was James who set up Russo to give England an early lead, which our attacker doubled on 16 minutes with a ferocious left-footed strike that rose into the top corner. Georgia Stanway added a third before James bagged her second and England’s fourth, finishing first time from Lauren Hemp’s delivery. It was James’ final contribution of note as she was withdrawn at the interval following a scintillating 45-minute performance. Potter was replaced by Jess Park on the hour having impressed on her big day. Walsh played the full 90 minutes and set up England’s final goal scored by Russo. Sarina Wiegman’s side play Ukraine in round two. Returning to the starting line-up after serving a first-leg suspension, Katie McCabe made an immediate impact for the Republic of Ireland as they wrapped up a commanding 4–0 victory over Kazakhstan. Wearing the captain's armband, McCabe led from the front and capped off an energetic performance by getting on the scoresheet shortly after the break, firing home in the 49th minute to double Ireland's lead. The emphatic 12-0 aggregate win means Ireland comfortably advance to the next round of qualifying, where they will play Poland. Nathalie Bjorn opened the scoring with a deflected effort as Sweden thrashed Lithuania 10-0 in the second leg of their play-off. Bjorn, who captained Sweden, was withdrawn at half-time with her side already 6-0 ahead. They will face Erin Cuthbert’s Scotland in the next round in what promises to be a fascinating contest. Scotland led 2-0 after the first leg against Czech Republic and made sure of progression with a 3-2 victory in Paisley. Cuthbert was introduced at half-time with the Scots trailing 2-1, but she helped her nation come back to win, providing the dangerous cross that set up the winning goal scored by Christy Grimshaw. Livia Peng kept a clean sheet in Switzerland’s 2-0 victory over Israel, which completed a 9-3 aggregate win. The Swiss will meet Austria next. Veerle Buurman played 70 minutes as the Netherlands despatched Hungary 3-0 to win 11-0 on aggregate. Next up for the Netherlands is a two-legged tie against Slovenia. In Florence, Giulia Dragoni was introduced on the hour as Italy drew 1-1 with Belarus, sealing a 3-1 aggregate success. They will meet Finland in the next round. With their place in the 2027 Women's World Cup already secured, Germany played a friendly against Japan on Tuesday. Club team-mates Sjoeke Nusken and Maika Hamano went up against each other as the European side secured a 2-1 victory. Nusken played all 90 minutes of the encounter, in which Germany came from a goal behind, while Hamano was introduced as a 68th-minute substitute. Over in Australia, Ellie Carpenter was an unused substitute as the Matildas romped to a 7-1 friendly win over  Haiti. Meanwhile, Becky Spencer started for Jamaica as they succumbed to a 3-1 friendly defeat to Mexico. On Monday evening, Kadeisha Buchanan played the first half of Canada’s 4-3 friendly defeat to Denmark in Toronto. Before kick-off, Buchanan and her former Chelsea team-mates Ashley Lawrence and Jessie Fleming were honoured for reaching the milestone of 150 appearances for Canada. Buchanan lined up at centre-back for Casey Stoney’s side, who went into the interval 3-1 down and, despite fighting back, were beaten 4-3. It was their final warm-up game before the CONCACAF W Championship, which starts late next month. Finally, Emma Hayes' USA side battled to a hard-earned 2-2 draw against Spain after suffering a 2-0 defeat to the reigning World Champions last Saturday. Alyssa Thompson started the match as La Roja once again found themselves 2-0 up, before a goal from Ashley Sanchez pulled one back for the home side early in the second half. Thompson was switched for her sister Giselle after an hour, and the draw was clinched late on with an 86th-minute volley from Mallory Swanson.
news.body_zh: 对于几名正在执行国家队任务的切尔西球员来说，这是一个美好的夜晚，因为她们参加 2027 年女足世界杯的希望仍然存在。明年夏天在巴西举行的欧洲杯预选赛取得了全面胜利，参赛者现在将注意力转向下个月的第二轮也是最后一轮附加赛。在王权球场，劳伦·詹姆斯上半场梅开二度，切尔西青训学院毕业生莱克西·波特也为母狮队首次亮相，帮助英格兰轻松战胜希腊，当晚以 5-0 获胜，总比分 8-1。波特与凯拉·沃尔什一起出现在英格兰中场的中场，延续了本赛季被证明非常有效的合作关系。汉娜·汉普顿 (Hannah Hampton) 首发门将，而詹姆斯则排在阿莱西奥·鲁索 (Alessio Russo) 身后的 10 号位置。正是詹姆斯助攻鲁索让英格兰队早早取得领先，我们的攻击手在第 16 分钟以一记凶猛的左脚射门将球打入球门上角。乔治亚·斯坦威 (Georgia Stanway) 打进第三球，詹姆斯则获得第二球和英格兰队的第四球，劳伦·汉普 (Lauren Hemp) 首次完成比赛。这是詹姆斯最后一次值得注意的贡献，她在一场精彩的 45 分钟表演后中场休息时退场。杰西·帕克在她的大喜之日给波特留下了深刻的印象，她在这一小时被杰西·帕克取代。沃尔什踢满了90分钟，并助攻鲁索为英格兰队打进最后一球。萨琳娜·维格曼的球队在第二轮对阵乌克兰。凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 在首回合停赛后回到首发阵容，立即为爱尔兰共和国队带来了影响，最终以 4-0 战胜了哈萨克斯坦队。戴着队长袖标的麦凯布在前场领先，中场休息后不久就取得进球，并在第 49 分钟射门得分，将爱尔兰的领先优势扩大一倍，结束了充满活力的表现。总比分 12-0 的大胜意味着爱尔兰轻松晋级下一轮预选赛，他们将对阵波兰。附加赛次回合，纳塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 射门偏出，瑞典队以 10-0 大胜立陶宛队。瑞典队队长比约恩在半场结束时退场，当时瑞典队已经6-0领先。他们将在下一轮对阵艾琳·卡斯伯特的苏格兰队，这场比赛有望成为一场精彩的比赛。苏格兰首回合2-0领先捷克，并在佩斯利3-2获胜确保晋级。半场结束时，苏格兰队 2-1 落后，库斯伯特上场，但她帮助国家队逆转取胜，她的一记危险传中帮助克里斯蒂·格里姆肖攻入致胜一球。瑞士队2-0战胜以色列队，彭丽媛保持不失球，总比分9-3获胜。瑞士队接下来将迎战奥地利队。维尔勒·布尔曼出战70分钟，荷兰队3-0击败匈牙利队，总比分11-0获胜。荷兰接下来将与斯洛文尼亚进行两回合比赛。在佛罗伦萨，朱利亚·德拉戈尼（Giulia Dragoni）在比赛中登场，意大利队1-1战平白俄罗斯队，最终以总比分3-1获胜。下一轮他们将迎战芬兰队。德国队已经获得了 2027 年女足世界杯的参赛资格，周二他们与日本队进行了一场友谊赛。俱乐部队友 Sjoeke Nusken 和 Maika Hamano 展开对决，欧洲球队以 2-1 获胜。努斯肯打满了这场比赛的90分钟，德国队在落后一球的情况下上场，而滨野在第68分钟替补上场。在澳大利亚，埃莉·卡彭特（Ellie Carpenter）作为替补未上场，帮助玛蒂尔达队以 7-1 战胜海地队。与此同时，贝基·斯宾塞 (Becky Spencer) 为牙买加首发，他们在友谊赛中以 3-1 输给了墨西哥。周一晚上，卡黛莎·布坎南在多伦多举行的加拿大4-3负于丹麦的友谊赛中踢了上半场比赛。开赛前，布坎南和她的前切尔西队友阿什利·劳伦斯和杰西·弗莱明因为加拿大队出场 150 场而获得荣誉。布坎南在凯西·斯托尼的球队中担任中后卫，球队进入中场休息时以1-3落后，尽管进行了反击，但还是以4-3被击败。这是他们在下个月底开始的中北美洲及加勒比海女子锦标赛之前的最后一场热身赛。最终，艾玛·海耶斯的美国队在上周六以 2-0 输给卫冕世界冠军西班牙队后，以 2-2 战平西班牙队，来之不易。 艾莉莎·汤普森 (Alyssa Thompson) 首发出场，西班牙队再次以 2-0 领先，下半场早些时候，阿什利·桑切斯 (Ashley Sanchez) 的进球为主队扳回一球。一个小时后，汤普森被换成了她的妹妹吉赛尔，马洛里·斯旺森在第 86 分钟的抽射最终锁定了平局。

Following the release of Samba Blues in February, which celebrated the powerful connection between Chelsea and Brazil, our latest release focuses on the story of our brilliant young Brazilian. I Am Estevao charts the unique journey of Estevao Willian from the city of Franca in south-east Brazil, through the Santos and Palmeiras youth systems, to arriving in London and that incredible goal against Barcelona. There is exclusive input from Estevao’s family and early coaches, who describe the boy who would become the man we see in Blue today, as well as from Chelsea legends such as Thiago Silva and David Luiz. Estevao also provides an insight into why he chose Chelsea, playing against his future employees at the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup and what Cole Palmer said to him after that game. news.body_en: Cobham Next Gen earned a crucial 2-0 victory over Reading in the EFL Trophy, with Chizaram Ezenwata's brace enough to earn all three points in our final group stage match. Ezenwata broke the deadlock in the 21st minute when he was in the right place at the right time to capitilise on Jack Stevens’ spill. He made it two just a few minutes later with a cultured finish in front of the away supporters. CNG held their own against senior opposition Reading, defending in solid fashion when needed before launching attacks of their own. We chased a third in the second half, but in the end our early goals were enough to secure the win. Chelsea managed to settle into the game after absorbing Reading’s attacking waves in the initial phases. After 21 minutes, the Blues were rewarded for their patience with a first goal of the evening. Harrison Bettoni picked up the ball out on the right and darted towards goal. He beat his defender before unleashing a powerful strike which was subsequently spilled by Reading goalkeeper Stevens. The ball fell at Ezenwata’s feet, and the CNG striker made no mistake from close range. Ezenwata doubled his tally and our advantage only four minutes later. Leo Black marked his EFL Trophy debut for Chelsea with an assist, as he dispossessed Conor Masterson before playing a pass into Ezenwata. The 18-year-old buried his strike through the legs of Stevens to make it 2-0. Ezenwata could have had a first-half hat-trick had it not been for the offside flag, after he dinked the ball over Stevens and into the back of the net. While there was plenty to be pleased with in attack for Chelsea, goalkeeper Freddy Bernal made some top stops both before and after we took the lead. Reading’s early chances didn’t really trouble Bernal, but he met their strong efforts equally as assured. The pick of the bunch came in the 36th minute when Daniel Kyerewaa’s thunderous strike seemed destined for the bottom-left corner. Bernal got across well and turned the shot away, before meeting the consequent corner first and palming the ball away from danger. Bettoni came close to extending our lead even further on a number of occasions. Sol Gordon’s cross towards the back post found the Chelsea forward, whose shot was just wide. He had another effort denied by Stevens, earning a corner. Bettoni created some good chances for his team-mates too, in particular Black. The 19-year-old played the ball into Black’s path, allowing him to strike the ball first time and forcing the goalkeeper into an unorthodox save with his feet. Bettoni was unable to get his name on the scoresheet but Ezenwata’s first-half contributions were enough to send Chelsea back home with our first win in the EFL Trophy this season. The result means Chelsea finish the group stage with five points, putting us in second place in Group F. We will await other results to confirm our progression to the next round. Cobham Next Gen return to league action on Friday 16 October, when we face Stoke City at Clayton Wood Training Ground. The fixture kicks off at 7pm and can be watched live with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 科巴姆下一代队在 EFL 奖杯赛中以 2-0 击败雷丁队，凭借奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔的梅开二度，在小组赛最后一场比赛中全取三分。 Ezenwata 在第 21 分钟打破了僵局，他在正确的时间出现在正确的位置，利用了杰克·史蒂文斯的突破。几分钟后，他在客场球迷面前以一记优雅的射门将比分扳平。 CNG在对阵高级反对派雷丁的比赛中坚守住了自己的阵地，在需要时进行了稳健的防守，然后再发起自己的进攻。我们在下半场追赶了第三名，但最终我们早早的进球足以确保胜利。切尔西在最初阶段吸收了雷丁的进攻浪潮后成功地融入了比赛。 21分钟后，蓝军的耐心得到了回报，攻入了当晚的第一个进球。哈里森·贝托尼从右侧接球，冲向球门。他击败了防守队员，然后发动了一次强力射门，随后被雷丁门将史蒂文斯挡出。球落在了Ezenwata的脚下，CNG前锋近距离没有失误。仅仅四分钟后，Ezenwata 的得分就翻了一番，我们的优势也增加了一倍。利奥·布莱克 (Leo Black) 在将球传给埃森瓦塔 (Ezenwata) 之前，将康纳·马斯特森 (Conor Masterson) 断球，并送出助攻，标志着他在切尔西的联赛首秀。这位18岁的球员的射门穿过史蒂文斯的腿，将比分改写为2-0。如果不是越位旗子，埃森瓦塔本可以在上半场上演帽子戏法，当时他将球越过了史蒂文斯并入网。虽然切尔西的进攻有很多值得高兴的地方，但门将弗雷迪·伯纳尔在我们取得领先之前和之后都做出了一些顶球扑救。雷丁早期的机会并没有真正困扰伯纳尔，但他同样确信无疑地迎接了他们的大力进攻。第 36 分钟，丹尼尔·凯雷瓦 (Daniel Kyerewaa) 的雷霆般的射门似乎命中了左下角，成为了这群人中的佼佼者。伯纳尔很好地传球，将射门挡开，然后首先接到下一个角球，并将球从危险中扑出。贝托尼多次差点扩大我们的领先优势。索尔·戈登的传中找到了切尔西前锋，后者的射门稍稍偏出。他的另一次射门被史蒂文斯挡出，获得角球。贝托尼也为队友创造了一些好机会，尤其是布莱克。这位 19 岁的球员将球传到布莱克的路径上，让他第一次射门，并迫使守门员用脚进行了非正统的扑救。贝托尼未能在进球表上留下自己的名字，但埃森瓦塔上半场的贡献足以让切尔西带着本赛季在联赛杯中的首场胜利回到主场。这个结果意味着切尔西以 5 分结束小组赛，使我们在 F 组中排名第二。我们将等待其他结果来确认我们是否晋级下一轮。科巴姆下一代将于 10 月 16 日星期五重返联赛，届时我们将在克莱顿伍德训练场迎战斯托克城。比赛将于晚上 7 点开始，订阅 CFC+ 即可观看直播。切尔西：50。弗雷迪·伯纳尔； 56.阿尔菲·奥斯本，48.贾斯汀·奥萨吉，37.奥鲁塔约·苏布洛耶（中）； 31.雷吉·沃森，51.利奥·布莱克，46.肯德利·佩兹（32.马赫迪·尼科尔-贾祖利），47.哈里森·麦克马洪； 52. 哈里森·贝托尼、62. 奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔、55. 索尔·戈登未上场替补：60. 托比·贝尔、61. 马蒂斯·埃布、66. 易卜拉欣·拉巴伊、69. 丹特·维特、74. 赫泽·格里姆韦德、85. 基安 最佳得分手：埃森瓦塔 21、25 黄牌：贝托尼 79、沃顿 91，麦克马洪 91 雷丁：25。杰克·斯蒂芬斯； 39. news.title_zh: 18岁以下英超联赛报告：雷丁0-3切尔西
news.body_en: Eden Perez, Isaac McGillvary and Eliah Semakula were all on target as Chelsea secured a 3-0 away win over Reading in the Under-18s Premier League South. Perez tucked the ball past Franky Rose just after the half-hour mark to break the deadlock; the schoolboy has now netted in back-to-back league matches after scoring in our 5-0 win over Bournemouth before the international break. The Blues found plenty of success down the right wing in the opening period, with Riley Ebho and Ibrahim Rabbaj doubling up on the Reading full-back effectively. Yet it wasn't until the second period that we added to our lead. McGillvary was a constant thorn in the Royals' side and doubled our advantage three minutes after the restart. We were reduced to ten men when Gabriel Sambou was dismissed, but the Blues showed our resilience by standing firm in defence and then adding to our advantage, with Eliah Semakula scoring late on to seal an impressive win. The Blues dominated the first half, creating several good opportunities and not allowing Reading to string a collection of passes together. Our biggest threat came down the right flank, where Ebho caused lots of problems on the overlap. He had our first attempt of the afternoon: a firm effort down the throat of Reading goalkeeper Franky Rose, who pushed the ball behind for a corner. The 17-year-old continued to threaten in advanced areas. One give-and-go with Rabbaj led to Andrew Pennie coming close, as his sweeping shot went just wide of the far post. Against the run of play, Reading’s Aiden Smith struck the crossbar after cutting inside, but it felt only a matter of time before we broke the deadlock. And in the 32nd minute, the goal arrived. McGillvary collected the ball on the left wing and played a pass inside to Perez. He produced a first-time finish into the bottom corner to score his fourth goal of the campaign and put us ahead. We then had a flurry of chances to double our lead, with Rabbaj hitting the post after beating two defenders with his quick feet. McGillvary doubled our lead quickly after the restart. Taking control of the ball on the left flank, he cut inside before being forced to turn his back to goal. Yet he spun away from a challenge and dispatched a left-footed shot beyond Rose and into the bottom corner. Reading hit the crossbar once again in the second half, this time through a Christian Cary free-kick, which came after Sambou was shown a straight red card. Being a man down, the Blues had to showcase our defensive abilities for the first time in the contest. We held off the hosts and managed to come away with a clean sheet, as well as a third goal via Semakula. Perez appeared set for his second of the afternoon but had the ball snatched from his feet by Rose. However, Semakula followed up to finish the attack with a goal and round off our victory. This victory means Chelsea remain second in the Under-18 Premier League on 15 points after seven matches. We trail the league leaders by just one point.
