news.title: Opening accounts: Henderson joins list of Stamford Bridge debut scorers
news.title_zh: 开户：亨德森加入斯坦福桥首秀得分手名单
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson immediately endeared himself to the Stamford Bridge faithful when he became the latest player to score on his Premier League home debut for the Blues. Henderson wasted little time announcing himself in SW6, bending a wonderful strike in off the post to give us the lead against Bournemouth with not even two minutes on the clock. The midfielder then set up Morgan Rogers' goal that instantly followed, before curling a textbook free-kick into the net during the second half to round off our emphatic 5-1 victory. The 36-year-old joined an impressive list of players who have scored in their first Chelsea league game at the Bridge. Henderson is the 26th to do so in the Premier League era, the third to score a brace (after Mario Stanic and Gonzalo Higuain), and the first since 2023. On that occasion Axel Disasi opened his Blues account to draw us level against Liverpool on the opening day of the campaign - the sixth consecutive season in which a Chelsea player achieved that feat. A season earlier, fellow defender Kalidou Koulibaly notched on his home debut as we drew 2-2 with Tottenham, while Academy product Trevoh Chalobah marked his Premier League bow against Crystal Palace in 2021/22 with a memorable long-range stunner in the second half that sealed a 3-0 victory. Palace were also our opponents in 2020/21 when Ben Chilwell made his Chelsea league debut after sitting out our first three games of the campaign with an injury. The left-back made up for lost time, breaking the deadlock by slamming in a loose ball from close range early in the second half, before crossing for Kurt Zouma to head home our second in an emphatic 4-0 win.A year earlier, it was Mason Mount who delighted the home fans when he found the net against Leicester City just seven minutes into his first senior appearance at the Bridge. Mount, who like Chalobah, was an Academy product, caught Wilfred Ndidi in possession on the edge of the box and slotted the ball past Kasper Schmeichel before celebrating in front of the Shed End. While Higuain never quite found his best form during his loan spell with the Blues in the second half of the 2018/19 season, the Argentinian enjoyed his home league debut as he netted two stunning goals against Huddersfield Town. After opening the scoring against the Terriers with a fine finish at the near post following an excellent through ball by N’Golo Kante, Higuain netted our fourth after the interval with a sensational right-footed effort from 25 yards as we ran out 5-0 winners. The recent trend began in 2017/18 when Alvaro Morata came off the bench to score against Burnley in our season opener. It proved to be a disappointing day as we lost 3-2 after being reduced to ten men for much of the game, but Morata made his mark when he glanced in a Willian cross 11 minutes after he had replaced Michy Batshuayi. Several other players have made a quick impression on Chelsea fans by netting on their home league debuts for the Blues in the Premier League era. In 2014/15, Diego Costa got off the mark at the Bridge by opening the scoring in our 2-0 win over Leicester as he plundered nine goals in his first seven Premier League matches. Loic Remy wasn’t nearly as prolific as the Brazilian, but the French striker found the net eight minutes after coming on as a substitute in our 4-2 win over Swansea in September 2014. And two-time Chelsea Player of the Year Juan Mata also scored after making his debut as a substitute when he sealed a 3-1 win over Norwich City in August 2011. Other players who have scored for the Blues on their league debuts at the Bridge since the turn of the millennium include George Weah (Tottenham Hotspur, January 2000), Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink, Stanic (both against West Ham, August 2000), Boudewijn Zenden (Newcastle 2001), Adrian Mutu (Leicester, August 2003), Claudio Pizarro, Florent Malouda (both against Birmingham City, August 2007) and Deco (Portsmouth, August 2008). news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森成为最新一位在蓝军英超主场首秀中进球的球员，立即赢得了斯坦福桥球迷的喜爱。亨德森很快就在 SW6 中展现了自己的实力，在比赛还剩不到两分钟的时候，他就在门柱外射出一记精彩的射门，帮助我们在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中取得了领先。这位中场球员随后助攻摩根·罗杰斯攻入一球，并在下半场将一记教科书般的任意球入网，最终我们以 5-1 取得了胜利。这位 36 岁的球员加入了在蓝桥的首场切尔西联赛中进球的球员名单，令人印象深刻。亨德森是英超时代第 26 位取得梅开二度的球员，也是第三位梅开二度的球员（仅次于马里奥·斯坦尼奇和冈萨洛·伊瓜因），也是自 2023 年以来的第一位。当时，阿克塞尔·迪萨西在赛季首日开启了他的蓝军账户，帮助我们在对阵利物浦的比赛中扳平比分——这是切尔西球员连续第六个赛季实现这一壮举。一个赛季前，后卫卡利杜·库利巴利在我们2-2战平热刺的比赛中完成了他的主场首秀，而青训球员特雷沃·查洛巴则在2021/22赛季对阵水晶宫的英超联赛中在下半场以一记令人难忘的远射，帮助球队以3-0获胜，标志着他在英超联赛中的首秀。水晶宫也是我们 2020/21 Kante）的精彩直塞球在近门柱处精彩射门首开纪录，伊瓜因在中场休息后以 25 码外的一记精彩右脚射门攻入我们的第四个进球，最终我们以 5-0 获胜。最近的趋势始于2017/18赛季，当时阿尔瓦罗·莫拉塔在赛季揭幕战对阵伯恩利的比赛中替补出场并进球。事实证明这是令人失望的一天，我们在比赛的大部分时间里都只剩下十人，最终以 3-2 落败，但莫拉塔在替换米奇·巴舒亚伊后 11 news.title: Inside the life of Wieke Kaptein
news.title_zh: Wieke Kaptein 的生活内部
news.body_en: Wieke Kaptein fills us in on her footballing journey and how she likes to spend her time behind the scenes. Could you start by telling us where you grew up and what it was like? I grew up in the east of Holland. And it's lovely. It's not really a city; there are a lot of farms. I was always outside. What age did you start playing football? What was the name of your first grassroots team? Achilles 12.That was my beginner's club. It was really lovely because I always played with the boys. Then I went to FC Twente. Who has been the biggest influence on your football career to date? What's been your career highlight to date? Playing at the World Cup in 2023 when I was 17. Who are your best friends in football? Marisa Olislagers, Fieke Kroese, and Aggie Beever-Jones. Could you name your top three favourite players of all time? Pedri, Frenkie de Jong, and I really like Fermin (Lopez) right now. What do you like to do away from football? How do you switch off? I love to walk with my dog, of course - drink coffee with friends. But I try to do something to help other people, try to set something up. So that's very nice. It's a nonprofit, and we're just figuring it out right now and building up. Are you watching any TV series currently?Young Sherlock Holmes. It's really good. I watched it with a friend of mine. If we looked at your Spotify playlist, who's dominating your most-played artists of the year?I love Spanish music. Kapo, Bad Bunny, things like that. What are your top three holiday destinations, either that you’ve been to or want to visit?I would love to go with my brothers to Africa. But of the places I've been... Australia, and I really like Switzerland. If you had guests over for dinner, what would you cook for them?Sweet potatoes with meat and all the vegetables. Can you tell the fans something they might not know about you?Probably, but I can't tell them... What's the best piece of advice you've ever received?Keep both feet on the ground no matter what happens, and always help other people. Finally, what does football mean to you?
news.body_zh: Wieke Kaptein 向我们讲述了她的足球之旅以及她喜欢在幕后度过的时光。您能首先告诉我们您在哪里长大以及是什么样的吗？我在荷兰东部长大。这很可爱。它并不是真正的城市；它是一座城市。有很多农场。我总是在外面。您几岁开始踢足球？你的第一个草根团队叫什么名字？阿喀琉斯 12.那是我的初学者俱乐部。这真的很可爱，因为我总是和男孩们一起玩。然后我去了特温特足球俱乐部。迄今为止，谁对您的足球生涯影响最大？迄今为止，您的职业生涯亮点是什么？当我 17 岁的时候参加 2023 年世界杯。谁是你在足球界最好的朋友？玛丽莎·奥利斯拉格斯、菲克·克罗斯和阿吉·比弗-琼斯。你能说出你最喜欢的三名球员吗？佩德里、弗兰基·德容和我现在真的很喜欢费明（洛佩兹）。足球之外你喜欢做什么？你如何关闭？当然，我喜欢和我的狗一起散步——和朋友一起喝咖啡。但我尝试做一些事情来帮助其他人，尝试做一些事情。所以这非常好。这是一个非营利组织，我们现在正在解决这个问题并不断发展。你现在在看什么电视剧吗？《少年夏洛克·福尔摩斯》。真的很好。我和我的一个朋友一起看了。如果我们查看您的 Spotify 播放列表，谁在您年度播放次数最多的艺术家中占据主导地位？我喜欢西班牙音乐。卡波、坏兔子等等。您去过或最想去的三个度假胜地是什么？我很想和我的兄弟们一起去非洲。但在我去过的地方中……澳大利亚，我真的很喜欢瑞士。如果你有客人来吃晚饭，你会为他们做什么？红薯加肉和所有蔬菜。你能告诉粉丝一些他们可能不知道的关于你的事情吗？可能，但我不能告诉他们...你收到过的最好的建议是什么？无论发生什么，都要脚踏实地，永远帮助别人。最后，足球对你来说意味着什么？

news.title: Morgan Rogers on starting fast and which Chelsea player is a 'machine'
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯谈起步快以及哪位切尔西球员是“机器”
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers has given credit to Xabi Alonso for the way Chelsea have come flying out of the blocks in matches this season and explained why he believes Jordan Henderson’s impressive home debut is just the beginning of what the midfielder can do for the Blues. Rogers found the net against Bournemouth on Saturday to put us 2-0 up in just the third minute of the game, as we raced into the lead on our way to a 5-1 victory over the Cherries at Stamford Bridge. It was the fastest that Chelsea have ever taken a two-goal lead in the Premier League - and it was no fluke. We have scored the opening goal inside the first seven minutes in five our of six league games so far this season, with five goals scored inside the first four minutes of matches alone. However, even among that trend, Bournemouth was something special, as Henderson gave us the lead with just one minute played and then teed up Rogers to got a second almost immediately from the restart. ‘It was a bit mad,’ reflected Rogers. ‘I think we were on the front foot straight away and that's what you’ve got to be, especially at home. You’ve got to get the crowd behind you. ‘It was against a really good team. They're playing really well and really good football at the moment, and we knew it was going to be tough. ‘To start like that, it gives you such an advantage moving forward into the game and that kind of set us off and got the precedent rolling. That's all you can ask for really. ‘I put it down to the manager's team talks before. He gets us firing, gets us going. But we always want to start off on the front foot. ‘It's about starting the game well and getting the lead, and that's been a lot of the games, especially at home, that we've kind of jumped on the back of scoring early goals. So it's a good trait to have and we need to keep it going.’ Henderson was making his first appearance for the Blues at the Bridge since joining in the summer and marked the occasion in style, with a fine opening goal followed by the assist for Rogers and then an unstoppable free-kick to complete the scoring. Not that the veteran midfielder’s starring role came as a surprise for his team-mates. ‘People said he was too old and you see what he does,’ Rogers continued. ‘Everyone in the dressing room knows that he's probably still the fittest player at the club, to be honest. He's a machine. ‘People forget about the football because they just think he's that experienced head, but don't get me wrong, the guy can still play football. He's won everything in the game. You saw his quality there and we'll see it for the rest of the season, I'm sure. ‘Hopefully we’ll see more goals from him. He's got the ability, super quality. That's why he's on the free-kick, because he's got that ability to score from distance, and he did it twice on Saturday.’ That praise comes despite Rogers missing out on free-kick duty to Henderson over the international break, with the 24-year-old laughing as he explained: ‘It was a work thing last week before I was there actually. They did it behind my back and then when I've got back I'm off free-kicks all of a sudden! Which I wasn't the best happy about, but as long as we score, that's the most important thing.’ The victory over Bournemouth takes Chelsea up to sixth place in the Premier League table, only outside of the top four on goal difference. However, Rogers echoed the sentiment shared by Alonso that it is still too early in the season to be drawing conclusions on how the campaign will take shape, with the Blues just approaching things one game at a time. ‘As the manager said, and he's been saying all week, which is a good one which I'm going to use now: “We can finish bottom or we can finish first”. There's not been enough games to determine where we can finish and what we can do, and that's how we're taking it. ‘We want to improve ourselves and look at ourselves, which we will do, but we're not looking up and not looking down. We're just looking at ourselves, at how we can improve and get better, and there's a massive improvement already from the international break and having time off and players working. ‘We're working with the manager and trying to improve, so it's been really good, and we've just got to keep moving forward and stay focused.’
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯对哈维·阿隆索在本赛季切尔西在比赛中的表现表示赞赏，并解释了为什么他相信乔丹·亨德森令人印象深刻的主场首秀只是这位中场球员为蓝军所做的事情的开始。周六对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中，罗杰斯的进球让我们在比赛第 3 分钟就以 2-0 领先，随后我们在斯坦福桥以 5-1 战胜樱桃队，取得了领先。这是切尔西在英超联赛中以两球领先的最快速度——而且这绝非侥幸。本赛季迄今为止的六场联赛中，我们有五场在前七分钟内就取得了首个进球，仅在比赛的前四分钟内就有五个进球。然而，即使在这种趋势中，伯恩茅斯也很特别，因为亨德森在比赛仅一分钟时就为我们带来了领先，然后在比赛重新开始后几乎立即为罗杰斯提供了第二个机会。 “这有点疯狂，”罗杰斯反映道。 “我认为我们立刻就处于领先地位，这就是你必须做到的，尤其是在主场。你必须让人群支持你。 ‘这是对阵一支非常优秀的球队。他们现在踢得非常好，足球非常好，我们知道这会很艰难。 “以这样的方式开始，它会给你在比赛中提供如此大的优势，这让我们开始并开创了先例。”这就是你真正能要求的。 “我把这归因于之前主帅团队的谈话。他让我们开火，让我们前进。但我们总是想先下手为强。 “关键在于开局良好并取得领先，在很多比赛中，尤其是在主场，我们都在早早进球的基础上取得了进展。这是亨德森自夏天加盟以来首次代表蓝军在蓝桥出场，他以漂亮的开场进球、助攻罗杰斯和一记势不可挡的任意球完成了进球。这位经验丰富的中场球员的主角角色并不让他的队友们感到意外。 “人们说他太老了，你看看他做了什么，”罗杰斯继续说道。 “说实话，更衣室里的每个人都知道他可能仍然是俱乐部里最健康的球员。他是一台机器。 “人们忘记了足球，因为他们只是认为他是一个经验丰富的头脑，但不要误会我的意思，这家伙仍然可以踢足球。他赢得了比赛中的一切。你在那里看到了他的品质，我相信我们会在本赛季剩余的比赛中看到它。 `希望我们能看到他更多的进球。他有能力，品质超群。这就是为什么他能主罚任意球，因为他有远距离得分的能力，而且他在周六就完成了两次。”尽管罗杰斯在国际比赛日期间错过了对亨德森的任意球，但这位24岁的球员笑着解释说：“上周在我真正到那里之前，这是一件工作事情。”他们在我背后这么做了，然后当我回来时，我突然就失去了任意球！我对此并不是最高兴的，但只要我们进球，那就是最重要的。”战胜伯恩茅斯后，切尔西在英超积分榜上上升到第六位，仅因净胜球差距而排在前四名之外。然而，罗杰斯回应了阿隆索的观点，即现在就赛季将如何进行下结论还为时过早，蓝军只是一场一场地进行比赛。 `正如主教练所说，他整个星期都在说，这是一个很好的说法，我现在要使用：“我们可以排名垫底，也可以排名第一”。还没有足够多的比赛来决定我们能在哪里完成以及我们能做什么，这就是我们的应对方式。 “我们想要提高自己，审视自己，我们会这么做，但我们不会向上看，也不会向下看。我们只是关注自己，关注如何改进并变得更好，从国际比赛日、休息时间和球员工作中已经取得了巨大的进步。 “我们正在与主教练合作并努力改进，所以这真的很好，我们必须继续前进并保持专注。”

news.title: Joao Pedro on benefits of the break, bonds and ‘brilliant’ Jordan Henderson
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 谈分手的好处、纽带和“才华横溢”的乔丹·亨德森 (Jordan Henderson)
news.body_en: Joao Pedro was back in the Chelsea team and back among the goals in Saturday’s big win over Bournemouth, with the Brazilian continuing his impressive start to the campaign. Injury ruled the striker out of our defeat at Brentford before the international break, and then stopped Joao Pedro linking up with the Selecao. While it was a frustrating period for our number nine, the pause allowed him to fully recover ahead of the Cherries’ visit. He duly responded with two typically well-taken second-half goals, taking his Premier League tally this season to five. ‘It was a brilliant game,’ said Joao Pedro. ‘The international break was a long time. We had time to work, to fix the mistakes against Brentford, and we got a great result. ‘Of course, you want to win with a clean sheet, so we need to keep working. Hopefully the next game we can get that, but it was a great game and three more points.’ Our front three once again looked potent, with Cole Palmer registering an assist and Morgan Rogers scoring as we continued our happy knack of finding the net early. Joao Pedro is clearly enjoying playing alongside that duo, and he offered some insight into why our attack are working so well in tandem. ‘We work hard. We try to know each other more every day and try to improve, so that's why we can show our quality in the game. ‘When you play close together, you can decide the game, and we showed that again. For me, I just try to be healthy and help my team-mates, and then we'll see what I can achieve.’ It helps when others chip in with goals and that was very much the case on Saturday, with Stamford Bridge debutant Jordan Henderson spectacularly finding the net in each half. The 36-year-old’s performance came as no surprise to Joao Pedro, who has observed what the midfielder offers this Blues group. ‘He is a brilliant player, he has had a lot of years in the Premier League and he is experienced. That’s why he joined us, to help us, and he showed he’s a top, top player. ‘He brings experience, he helps everyone, us in front, the guys at the back, he is a special player and he showed his qualities.’
news.body_zh: 若昂·佩德罗重返切尔西队，并在周六大胜伯恩茅斯的比赛中打进进球，巴西人继续着他本赛季令人印象深刻的开局。伤病使得这位前锋无法在国际比赛日之前输给布伦特福德，然后让若奥·佩德罗无法与桑巴军团联系。虽然这对我们的九号球员来说是一段令人沮丧的时期，但这次暂停让他在樱桃队来访之前完全康复。他在下半场以两个典型的精彩进球做出了回应，使他本赛季的英超进球数达到了五个。 “这是一场精彩的比赛，”若昂·佩德罗说道。 “国际比赛日的休息时间很长。我们有时间努力，纠正对阵布伦特福德的错误，我们取得了很好的结果。 “当然，你想以零失球的方式获胜，所以我们需要继续努力。希望下一场比赛我们能做到这一点，但这是一场精彩的比赛，还能再拿三分。”我们的前三名球员再次展现出强大的实力，科尔·帕尔默送出助攻，摩根·罗杰斯得分，我们继续早早进球的快乐秘诀。若昂·佩德罗显然很享受与这对搭档并肩作战，他提供了一些见解，解释了为什么我们的进攻如此协调一致。 ‘我们努力工作。我们每天都在努力更多地了解彼此并努力提高，这就是为什么我们可以在比赛中展示我们的实力。 “当你们踢得紧密时，你们就能决定比赛，我们再次证明了这一点。对我来说，我只是努力保持健康并帮助我的队友，然后我们就会看到我能取得什么成就。”当其他人贡献进球时，这会有所帮助，周六的情况就是如此，斯坦福桥首次亮相的乔丹·亨德森在每个半场都精彩地进球。若昂·佩德罗观察到了这位36岁中场球员为蓝军带来的贡献，他对这位36岁球员的表现并不感到意外。 “他是一名出色的球员，在英超联赛效力多年，经验丰富。这就是他加入我们、帮助我们的原因，他证明了自己是一名顶级球员。 “他带来了经验，他帮助了每个人，包括我们前面的球员，后面的球员，他是一名特殊的球员，他展示了自己的品质。”

news.title: Cole Palmer determined to repay Chelsea’s trust after new contract
news.title_zh: 科尔·帕尔默决心在新合同后回报切尔西的信任
news.body_en: Cole Palmer was pleased to return from the international break with a victory as he focuses on repaying the faith shown in him by Chelsea with his performances on the pitch after putting pen to paper on a new long-term contract. The forward signed a new deal committing his future to the Blues until at least 2034 on Saturday, before taking to the Stamford Bridge pitch as part of Xabi Alonso’s starting line-up to face Bournemouth in our first game since the international break. Palmer and his fellow Blues wasted no time getting back into the swing of things, our No10 setting up Jordan Henderson to open the scoring in the second minute, before Morgan Rogers put us two up straight from the restart. A Joao Pedro brace and a second from Henderson arrived in the second half to give us an emphatic 5-1 victory over the Cherries in our first home game for nearly a month. ‘It was a great win against a good side,’ said Palmer. ‘We knew it'd be difficult, but we played well. ‘It was a good day, especially having key players back. Having nearly the whole squad back, it was good, and I feel like this was a good start to the next games that we have.’ Palmer also had a hand in Henderson’s second goal, his surging run drawing a foul before providing the decoy run as the veteran midfielder curled a pinpoint free-kick into the top corner, a move he reveals was straight off the training ground. ‘We've just been working on it in training and when it came to it, we were thinking about what to do,’ Cole revealed. ‘But I just said to him: “We've worked on it”. He's done it well in training, so before his shot, I said: “Which corner flag are we running to when you put it in the top corner?". ‘And then we chose a corner flag, then he put it in the top corner, then we ran there. So it was funny. It was a good goal and a good day.’ A 5-1 victory felt like the perfect way to celebrate Palmer’s new contract, announced earlier in the day, with the 24-year-old eager to continue showing Chelsea’s faith in him is well placed. ‘It feels nice,’ said Palmer, when asked about signing the contract. ‘Just thank you to the club for trusting me and I've got to keep repaying them. ‘I just work hard and try to give my best, that's all. I feel back to how I was and it's only early in the season, so just keep going. ‘It's still early with the manager and he's still trying to get his ideas across, but we're starting to adapt and especially this week we've been working on ideas and stuff like that, so it's been good.’
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默很高兴在国际比赛日结束后带着一场胜利归来，在签下一份新的长期合同后，他将专注于用自己在球场上的表现来回报切尔西对他的信任。周六，这位前锋签署了一份新合同，将他的未来承诺给蓝军，至少到2034年为止，然后作为哈维·阿隆索首发阵容的一部分出现在斯坦福桥球场，这是我们自国际比赛日以来的第一场比赛，对阵伯恩茅斯。帕尔默和他的蓝军队友立即恢复了状态，我们的 10 号球员在第二分钟助攻乔丹·亨德森首开纪录，随后摩根·罗杰斯在比赛重新开始后让我们两分领先。下半场若昂·佩德罗梅开二度，亨德森梅开二度，帮助我们以 5-1 击败樱桃队，这是我们近一个月来的首个主场比赛。 “这是一场对阵强队的伟大胜利，”帕尔默说道。 “我们知道这会很困难，但我们打得很好。 “这是美好的一天，尤其是关键球员回来了。几乎全队都回来了，这很好，我觉得这对我们接下来的比赛来说是一个良好的开端。”帕尔默也参与了亨德森的第二个进球，他的冲刺造成犯规，然后这位老将中场将一脚精准的任意球打入球门上角，他透露这一动作是在训练场上直接完成的。 “我们刚刚在训练中一直在努力，当谈到这个问题时，我们正在考虑该怎么做，”科尔透露。 “但我只是对他说：‘我们已经在努力了’。”他在训练中做得很好，所以在射门之前，我说：“当你把球放在上角时，我们要跑向哪个角旗？”。 “然后我们选择了一面角旗，然后他把它放在顶角，然后我们跑到那里。所以这很有趣。这是一个很好的进球，也是美好的一天。” 5-1 的胜利感觉像是庆祝帕尔默当天早些时候宣布的新合同的完美方式，这位 24 岁的球员渴望继续展示切尔西对他的信心。当被问及签署合同时，帕尔默说：“感觉很好。” “感谢俱乐部对我的信任，我必须继续回报他们。 “我只是努力工作并尽力做到最好，仅此而已。我感觉回到了以前的状态，现在才赛季初期，所以继续前进吧。 “对于主教练来说，现在还为时尚早，他仍在努力传达他的想法，但我们已经开始适应，特别是本周我们一直在研究想法和类似的东西，所以这很好。”

news.title: Chelsea Diary: Premier League trip, derby day and Academy action
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：英超之旅、德比日和青训营
news.body_en: What to look out for at Chelsea from Monday 12 October to Sunday 18 October, with away days, a London derby at Stamford Bridge and a busy week for our Academy sides. The Blues return to domestic action with fixtures across the men’s, women’s and Academy teams, while Chelsea supporters can also look forward to exclusive interviews, two pre-match press conferences and updates on our internationals. Here is your day-by-day guide to the week ahead. We begin the week by looking back on the men’s 5-1 Premier League victory over Bournemouth at Stamford Bridge. Match reaction will continue on the Chelsea Official App and website with interviews featuring Cole Palmer, Joao Pedro and Moises Caicedo. There will also be the latest from Cobham as Xabi Alonso’s squad turns its attention to Saturday’s trip to Everton, plus updates on Chelsea Women players who have been representing their countries during the international period. There is a double helping of Academy action on Tuesday. Chelsea Under-18s travel to Bearwood Park to face Reading in the Under-18 Premier League, with kick-off at 2pm. CFC+ subscribers can watch the game live in our Reading vs Chelsea Under-18s Match Centre. Later in the day, the Cobham Next Gen continue their EFL Trophy campaign with their own away trip to Reading. The group-stage fixture kicks off at 7pm, with team news, updates and reaction available across Chelsea’s official channels in our Reading vs Cobham Next Gen Match Centre. We will hear from Moises Caicedo as the midfielder reflects on his first three years as a Blue, describes how he can still get better, and underlines what targets he has in his sights. Our coverage will also include any further news and reaction involving Chelsea Women players on international duty, alongside the latest from the men’s and women’s squads at Cobham. Our exclusive documentary I Am Estevao charts the unique journey of Estevao Willian from the city of Franca in south-east Brazil, through the Santos and Palmeiras youth systems, to arriving in London and that incredible goal against Barcelona. The full documentary is released on CFC+ on Thursday. Attention then turns firmly to the weekend fixtures. We will bring you the latest training and team news as the men prepare to travel to Everton and Chelsea Women build towards a London derby with Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge. We will hear from both Chelsea head coaches ahead of their weekend matches. Xabi Alonso will preview the men’s Premier League trip to Everton in his pre-match press conference, while Sonia Bompastor will speak to the media before Chelsea Women host Tottenham at Stamford Bridge. Both press conferences will be shown live on the Chelsea Official App and website. There is also Friday-night action for Cobham Next Gen, who travel to Stoke City in the Premier League 2. Kick-off is at 7pm and the game will be shown live for CFC+ subscribers in the Stoke City vs Cobham Next Gen Match Centre. Saturday begins with the latest from Maika Hamano, who will feature in an exclusive interview ahead of Chelsea Women’s London derby the following day. On the pitch, Chelsea Under-18s are away again as they face West Bromwich Albion in the Under-18 Premier League at the Fitlife Foods Performance Centre. Kick-off is at midday live for CFC+ subscribers in our West Bromwich Albion vs Chelsea Under-18s Match Centre. Half-an-hour later, the men’s team return to Premier League action at Everton. The game at Hill Dickinson Stadium kicks off at 12.30pm. Supporters can follow the build-up, confirmed team news, minute-by-minute updates and live audio commentary in the Everton vs Chelsea Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, followed by highlights at 4.30pm. The week concludes with a London derby at Stamford Bridge as Chelsea Women host Tottenham Hotspur in the Women’s Super League. The match kicks off at midday. We will have all the build-up, team news and match action in the Chelsea Women vs Tottenham Hotspur Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, followed by a report, highlights and reaction from Bompastor and her players. Tickets for that match on Sunday are on sale now!
news.body_zh: 从 10 月 12 日星期一到 10 月 18 日星期日，切尔西有哪些值得关注的事情，其中​​包括客场比赛、斯坦福桥的伦敦德比以及我们青训队忙碌的一周。蓝军重返国内赛场，参加男队、女队和青训队的比赛，而切尔西的支持者也可以期待独家采访、两场赛前新闻发布会以及国际比赛的最新消息。这是您未来一周的每日指南。我们首先回顾一下男子英超联赛在斯坦福桥以 5-1 战胜伯恩茅斯的比赛。比赛反应将在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上继续进行，并对科尔·帕尔默、若昂·佩德罗和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多进行采访。随着哈维·阿隆索的球队将注意力转向周六对阵埃弗顿的比赛，科巴姆还将发布最新消息，以及在国际比赛期间代表国家队参赛的切尔西女足球员的最新消息。周二的学院行动有双重帮助。切尔西 U-18 队将前往贝尔伍德公园，在 U-18 英超联赛中迎战雷丁队，比赛将于下午 2 点开球。 CFC+ 订阅者可以在我们的雷丁 vs 切尔西 18 岁以下比赛中心现场观看比赛。当天晚些时候，科巴姆下一代队将客场前往雷丁，继续他们的 EFL 奖杯活动。小组赛比赛将于晚上 7 点开始，我们的雷丁对阵科巴姆下一代比赛中心的切尔西官方频道将提供球队新闻、更新和反应。我们将听取莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的发言，这位中场球员回顾了他作为蓝军的前三年，描述了他如何能够变得更好，并强调了他的目标。我们的报道还将包括涉及切尔西女足国际比赛的任何进一步新闻和反应，以及科巴姆男女队的最新消息。我们的独家纪录片《我是埃斯特瓦奥》记录了埃斯特瓦奥·威廉从巴西东南部弗兰卡市出发，经过桑托斯和帕尔梅拉斯青训系统，到达伦敦以及对阵巴塞罗那的令人难以置信的进球的独特旅程。完整的纪录片将于周四在 CFC+ 上发布。然后注意力就会转向周末的赛程。我们将为您带来最新的训练和球队新闻，男队准备前往埃弗顿，而切尔西女队则准备在斯坦福桥与托特纳姆热刺队进行伦敦德比。我们将在周末比赛前听到两位切尔西主教练的消息。哈维·阿隆索将在赛前新闻发布会上预览男子英超对阵埃弗顿的比赛，而索尼娅·邦帕斯托将在切尔西女足在斯坦福桥迎战托特纳姆热刺队之前向媒体发表讲话。两次新闻发布会都将在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上直播。周五晚上，科巴姆下一代 (Cobham Next Gen) 队将前往斯托克城参加英超 2 级联赛。开球时间为晚上 7 点，CFC+ 订阅者将在斯托克城对阵科巴姆下一代 (Cobham Next Gen) 比赛中心现场直播比赛。周六以滨野麻香 (Maika Hamano) 的最新消息开始，她将在第二天切尔西女子伦敦德比之前接受独家采访。球场上，切尔西 18 岁以下青年队再次客场作战，他们将在 Fitlife Foods 表演中心迎战 18 岁以下英超联赛的西布罗姆维奇队。中午，CFC+ 订阅者将在西布罗姆维奇对阵切尔西 18 岁以下比赛中心进行开球。半小时后，男队回到埃弗顿参加英超比赛。希尔迪金森体育场的比赛于中午 12 点 30 分开始。支持者可以在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上关注埃弗顿 vs 切尔西比赛中心的赛前集结、确认的球队新闻、每分钟更新和现场音频评论，然后在下午 4.30 观看精彩集锦。本周的女足超级联赛将以在斯坦福桥举行的伦敦德比战结束，切尔西女足将主场迎战托特纳姆热刺队。比赛于中午开始。我们将在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上提供切尔西女足对阵托特纳姆热刺比赛中心的所有赛前准备、球队新闻和比赛动态，然后是邦帕斯特和她的球员的报道、亮点和反应。周日那场比赛的门票现已发售！

In our last match, we came from behind to beat West London rivals Fulham 3-1 at Cobham. Harrison Bettoni and Reggie Watson turned the game on his head early on in the second half, before Leo Black ensured the victory with Chelsea’s third. We will now be searching for a crucial victory in the EFL Trophy when we face Reading.
